description: Job Summary The Senior Buyer is responsible for the strategic sourcing, negotiation, and procurement of fabricated and machined aerospace components. This role requires a deep understanding of aerospace materials, manufacturing processes, and supply base management to ensure quality, cost, and delivery objectives are met. The Senior Buyer will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Quality, Planning, and suppliers to support both development and production programs. This role will also lead supplier performance mitigation strategies and collaborate closely with Planning to ensure material requirements are accurately understood and met on time. JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Source, negotiate, and manage purchase orders for fabricated and machined aerospace parts, including precision components, assemblies, and subassemblies. Develop and maintain relationships with key suppliers to ensure consistent performance in cost, quality, and delivery. Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to understand technical requirements and translate them into sourcing strategies. Work closely with Planning to ensure material requirements are accurately communicated, understood, and met by suppliers in alignment with production schedules. Read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and bill of materials (BOMs) to validate supplier capability and quote accuracy. Conduct supplier evaluations, including capacity, capability, and risk assessments. Lead and execute supplier performance mitigation strategies for underperforming vendors, including creation of recovery plans, risk assessments, and dual/multi-sourcing strategies. Monitor supplier performance using scorecards and KPIs; identify performance gaps and initiate corrective actions in collaboration with Quality and Operations teams. Engage in root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts with suppliers to address recurring quality or delivery issues. Support new product introduction (NPI) by sourcing prototypes and transitioning to production suppliers. Negotiate and manage long-term agreements (LTAs), supplier contracts, and terms & conditions. Stay informed of market trends, commodity pricing, and geopolitical factors that may affect supply. Maintain ERP/MRP system accuracy for pricing, lead times, delivery dates, and supplier data integrity. Ensure timely delivery of materials and proactive resolution of potential supply chain disruptions. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or related field. 5–10 years of procurement experience in the aerospace industry, specifically with machined and fabricated parts. Strong understanding of CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, welding, and finishing processes. Proven ability to read and understand engineering drawings and GD&T. Experience with AS9100 requirements and aerospace supplier quality systems. Strong negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management skills. Demonstrated success in mitigating supplier performance risks and improving supply continuity. Experience working closely with Planning, Production Control, or Materials Management to align supply and demand. Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems; Epicor Kinetic experience a plus . Knowledge of ITAR, DFARS, and other regulatory requirements APICS, CPM, or CPSM certification (preferred). PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORKING CONDITIONS While performing the duties of this job, employees are regularly required to sit, walk and stand; talk or hear, both in person and by telephone; use their hands repetitively to finger, handle, feel or operate standard office equipment; reach with hands and arms; and lift up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The work environment characteristics described here represent those employee encounters while performing this job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Employees work under typical office conditions, and the noise level is usually quiet to moderate. However, in certain assignments, an employee may work near moving equipment and be exposed to toxic or caustic chemicals, biological hazards, airborne fumes, outdoor weather conditions, and loud, prolonged noise. description: Description Looking to join a passionate team dedicated to developing and manufacturing life-saving biopharmaceuticals? Avid Bioservices is a leading clinical and commercial biologics CDMO focused on creating innovative solutions to meet the needs of our clients and improve patient outcomes. Your Role: The Senior Procurement Specialist drives the organization's sourcing lifecycle to optimize costs, mitigate market risks, and guarantee supply continuity. This role balances strategic category leadership with execution, managing a diverse portfolio across both direct procurement (production-critical raw materials and inventory) and indirect procurement (operational goods, software, and corporate services). The ideal candidate acts as a strategic advisor to stakeholders and builds resilient, high-performing supplier networks. Key Responsibilities: Process purchase orders, track deliveries, and ensure timely receipt of goods Responsible for negotiating preferred/discount pricing or contract pricing with vendors. Maintain strong relationships with suppliers, monitor performance, and resolve disputes or claims. Partners with AP to resolve vendor invoice issues. Partners with MSAT to drive second sourcing activities for raw materials. Helps with obtaining vendor documentation for RMS updates for materials. Drive sourcing strategies for raw materials and core engineering components to ensure milestones are being met. Complex Contracting: Draft and negotiating complex, multi-year Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Help drive Key Performance Metrics (KPI’s) such as cost savings/avoidance, supplier performance and reduction in procurement cycle times. Managing high-value corporate spend categories (e.g., Enterprise Software, Global Facilities, Professional Services) and aligning procurement with executive business goals. Responsible for executing and managing enterprise-wide sourcing strategies for non-production goods and services. This role focuses on optimizing corporate spend, driving structural cost reduction initiatives, and building resilient supplier frameworks across high value spend categories. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related technical field. 5 to 8+ years of indirect/direct corporate procurement or category management experience. Experience with ERP / inventory control systems required, Dynamics D365 experience preferred. Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills. Preferred Qualifications: Professional certification (e.g., CPSM, MCIPS, or APICS/CSCP) is highly preferred. cGMP experience and writing SOP’s and contracts highly preferred. Elite negotiation skills with a proven track record of securing multi-million-dollar annual savings. Position Type/Expected Hours of Work: This role is a full-time onsite position in Tustin, CA. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. unless otherwise stated by Supervisor. The employee must also have the ability to work overtime and/or weekends when necessary. Compensation: We offer competitive compensation packages for this role, including a base salary, performance-based bonuses, and comprehensive benefits such as health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. The compensation range for this role is $24.23 - $30.28 hourly depending on experience and qualifications. Additionally, we offer opportunities for career growth and development as well as a supportive and inclusive work environment. Who you are: You have a "bring it on!" team player approach and an unshakable positive attitude, always ready to tackle anything that comes your way. Your written and verbal skills are out of this world, and you communicate with clarity and confidence. You have exceptional multitasking skills and an unparalleled attention to detail that ensure the smooth running of everything. You are a master at building relationships, capable of establishing connections with anyone, be it team members, clients, vendors, or suppliers. Physical Demands & Work Environment: In this dynamic role, expect a blend of regular activities like sitting, standing, and walking, with occasional physically engaging tasks such as lifting objects up to 25 pounds. The work environment might expose you to electrical shocks, toxic chemicals, vibrations, or loud noise levels occasionally. However, reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with different abilities to perform effectively, ensuring a supportive and adaptable work setting. Your visual acuity, including close, distance, and color vision, will be essential in navigating through the diverse day-to-day demands of this position.

description: Beehive Industries is dedicated to Powering American Defense by revolutionizing the design, development, and delivery of jet propulsion systems to support the warfighter. Through the integration of additive manufacturing, the company aims to meet the growing and urgent needs for unmanned aerial defense by dramatically improving a jet engine’s speed to market, fuel efficiency, and cost. Founded in 2020, the company is headquartered in Centennial, Colorado, with additional facilities in Knoxville, Tennessee, Loveland Ohio, and Mount Vernon, Ohio. Beehive is committed to grow and advance the defense industrial base while manufacturing exclusively in the USA. This role will be located at our Cincinnati, Ohio facility. Role Overview We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Buyer to own and support execution of all outside processing and special process requirements in a fast-paced aerospace and defense environment. This role owns the supplier relationship and purchasing process for outside services including non-destructive testing, heat treatment, and other specialized manufacturing services The Buyer works closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Supply Planning, and Program teams to ensure outside processing is completed in accordance with purchase order requirements, customer specifications, applicable aerospace standards, and required delivery schedules. This position is responsible for negotiating long term agreements, understanding supplier capacity and constraints, partnering with technical teams to qualify new sources and managing the complete outside-service process from purchase requisition through supplier execution. What You’ll Do... Manage purchase orders and supplier relationships for all assigned outside processing and special process requirements. Manage RFQs/RFPs, supplier selection, bid analysis, negotiations, and contract execution. Ensure full compliance with FAR/DFARS requirements and all government contracting regulations throughout the procurement process. Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Facilities, Quality, Finance, and Program Management teams to support business objectives. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, service agreements, and long-term supply arrangements. Develop and maintain supplier relationships to ensure performance in quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness. Identify and execute cost reduction, process improvement, and supply chain risk mitigation initiatives. Maintain accurate procurement records, purchase orders, and sourcing documentation within ERP/MRP systems. Support audits and documentation requirements related to AS9100, ISO standards, and government contracting compliance. Own supplier delivery performance for outside processing requirements and proactively manage material through the supplier network. Coordinate shipment of material to and from outside processors to support production schedules. Monitor supplier lead times, work-in-process, capacity constraints, and potential delivery risks. Support long-term agreements, pricing agreements, blanket purchase orders, and other commercial strategies where appropriate You have... Education Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field preferred. Experience 3–7+ years of purchasing or procurement experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or highly regulated industries. Skills & Competencies Demonstrated experience preparing, managing, and auditing procurement compliance documentation. Strong negotiation, analytical, and supplier management skills. Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems Ability to read and interpret statements of work, and technical specifications Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and procurement analytics. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance Nice to have... Experience in aerospace, defense, precision machining, additive, or advanced manufacturing environments. Experience supporting lean manufacturing or continuous improvement initiatives. Experience with long-term supply agreements and logistics Experience with ERP/MRP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar. If this sounds like you, please submit an application with your resume. This could be the opportunity you are looking for to expand your skills, contribute to a winning team, and work with talented people who love what they do and take pride in our mission. Beehive Industries offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes group Medical, Dental, Life, and Short and Long-Term disability coverage from day one. We also offer a generous 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with a Company match. Every role at Beehive Industries is bonus eligible and will also receive equity in the company. Beehive Industries is committed to full compliance with applicable anti-discrimination laws. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We strive to create an inclusive work environment and will not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

description: About Blue Bird Corporation Blue Bird (NASDAQ: BLBD) is recognized as a technology leader and innovator of school buses since its founding in 1927. Our dedicated team members design, engineer and manufacture school buses with a singular focus on safety, reliability, and durability. School buses carry the most precious cargo in the world – 25 million children twice a day – making them the most trusted mode of student transportation. The company is the proven leader in low- and zero-emission school buses with more than 25,000 propane, natural gas, and electric powered buses sold. Blue Bird is transforming the student transportation industry through cleaner energy solutions. For more information on Blue Bird’s complete product and service portfolio, visit www.blue-bird.com. JOB SUMMARY: Reporting to the Senior Manager, Purchasing, the Senior Buyer, Powertrain & Chassis Systems is responsible for leading the strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, and operational lifecycle management for powertrain, chassis, and assigned heavy mechanical and structural commodities. This role serves as the primary commercial and operational owner for critical components and systems, including engine and powertrain systems, transmissions and driveline, steering, braking, suspension, axles, wheels and tires, and assigned structural/mechanical systems. The position balances long-term cost optimization and supplier relationship management with aggressive hands-on risk mitigation, serving as the ultimate escalation point for production shortages, supplier recovery, and supply continuity planning to ensure uninterrupted vehicle assembly. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Commodity Strategy & Sourcing: Develop and execute comprehensive sourcing strategies for the Powertrain & Chassis Systems portfolio to optimize total cost of ownership (TCO), quality, and delivery. Supplier Risk & Crisis Management: Lead operational risk management, serve as the primary escalation point for critical chassis component shortages, and establish cross-functional crisis management teams to resolve supplier delivery failures. Contract & Cost Negotiation: Lead multi-million-dollar contract negotiations, long-term agreements (LTAs), and pricing reviews with major tier-1 automotive and heavy-duty commercial vehicle suppliers. Supplier Performance & Technical Recovery: Monitor On-Time Delivery (OTD) and quality governance; lead 8D root-cause investigations and corrective action plans directly with supplier manufacturing plants when quality or delivery targets are missing. Capacity & Vulnerability Mapping: Conduct regular supplier capacity reviews, tooling and manufacturing assessments, sub-tier dependency reviews, and vulnerability mapping to identify capacity constraints, long-lead components, and other supply continuity risks. Program Launch & Supplier Transition: Lead purchasing activities supporting new product introduction and supplier transition, including sourcing readiness, commercial closure, tooling, capacity validation, APQP/PPAP execution, early supplier engagement (ESI), and production launch readiness. Resilience Planning: Drive dual-sourcing and manufacturing contingency initiatives for high-risk, single-sourced components and systems. Operational Discipline: Develop KPI dashboards, manage material cost variance reporting, and mentor junior buyers and operational specialists within the purchasing team. REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Strong knowledge of automotive or commercial vehicle powertrain, chassis, driveline, and/or heavy mechanical systems. Advanced Sourcing & Negotiation: Proven track record of managing high-spend portfolios, executing complex supplier agreements, and navigating raw material (steel/aluminum) indexing. Operational Recovery: Demonstrated experience leading supplier recovery efforts and managing business continuity in high-pressure manufacturing environments. Quality & Engineering Literacy: Strong understanding of automotive quality standards, APQP, PPAP, blueprint reading, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T). Influence & Collaboration: Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders (Engineering, Quality, Operations) without direct authority. Systems Proficiency: High proficiency in ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or Infor) and advanced Microsoft Excel data analysis capabilities. description: Your role The Strategic Sourcing role is accountable for developing and executing a sustainable procurement strategy within their assigned commodity area. This includes establishing and managing long‑term agreements and service‑level commitments, optimising and rationalising the supplier base, and ensuring effective supplier onboarding. A key focus of the role is strengthening supply chain resilience by building. As Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager - Supplier Development, you will execute sourcing strategies that secure qualified capacity for production ramp-up and build a competitive, resilient supply base. You will lead supplier selection, negotiation, onboarding, qualification coordination, launch readiness, and performance, with particular focus on new product introduction, dual sourcing, and continuity of supply. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. Manager reflects accountability for sourcing strategies, supplier relationships, spend, contracts, risk, and results. What You Will Do Develop category and supplier strategies aligned with growth, NPI, production ramp-up, cost, capacity, quality, and supply-resilience priorities. Lead market analysis, RFIs, RFQs and RFPs, total-cost evaluation, negotiations, supplier selection, awards, and agreements. Assess suppliers for capability, capacity, processes, quality systems, financial health, scalability, compliance, and risk. Coordinate supplier onboarding and qualification across Engineering, Supplier Quality, Operations, Planning, Finance, and other functions, with clear milestones, owners, risks, and escalations. Facilitate product and part qualification, including specifications, samples, tooling, first articles, validation, deviation closure, approvals, and production release. Engineering and Quality own technical requirements, validation decisions, and formal approval; you drive supplier response, timing, commercial readiness, escalation, and completion. Secure capacity and launch readiness through reviews, forecasts, lead-time and flexibility commitments, inventory plans, and commercial agreements. Build dual-source and continuity plans for critical parts and single-source risks, coordinating alternate-source qualification with technical and quality teams. Lead supplier reviews, performance improvement, and recovery plans covering quality, delivery, capacity, cost, compliance, and risk. Deliver savings, cost avoidance, working-capital improvement, productivity, and total-cost benefits without compromising quality or continuity. Develop supplier relationships that improve access to capacity, technology, and innovation while meeting legal, ethical, sustainability, and Atlas Copco requirements. To succeed, you will need Typically 5-8 years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management, supplier development, procurement, or supply chain, preferably in engineered products or manufacturing. Success sourcing, negotiating with, qualifying, onboarding, and ramping suppliers for NPI or production growth. Experience coordinating suppliers and cross-functional teams through qualification and production release. Strong negotiation, contract management, cost analysis, total-cost, supplier-performance, and risk-management capabilities. Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, bills of material, manufacturing processes, and supplier-capability information. Strong communication, influence, judgment, analytical problem-solving, and project leadership without formal authority. Bachelor's degree in supply chain, engineering, business, operations, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Location and travel: This position may be remote within the United States or hybrid; residence near Saugerties, New York, is not required. Approximately 40% travel is expected, primarily to supplier sites for qualification, launch readiness, business reviews, improvement, and issue resolution, and to company locations. Travel will be mainly within North America, with international travel as needed. Arrangements are subject to company policy, employment eligibility, payroll and tax requirements, and business needs. In return, we offer Culture of trust and accountability Lifelong learning and career growth Innovation powered by people Comprehensive compensation and benefits 401k Automatic Company Contribution and match Generous PTO package Annual Variable Compensation Program Salary: $125,000-$150,000/yr Job location This position may be remote within the United States or hybrid; residence near Saugerties, New York, is not required. Contact information Talent Acquisition Team: Kasey Griffin Uniting curious minds Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

description:
At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day.

Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company's DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand.

Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world's most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more.

We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers.

We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty.

**This role is an Onsite Role:** This role requires full-time presence at our Oxford, North Carolina office.

**Overview:**

The **MRO Buyer II** is responsible for procuring the MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations) goods and services which keep the plant running effectively. At the highest level, this position must be internal customer focused; striving to provide the highest quality service and support to our internal customers while providing the most optimal total cost for MRO products and services. This position requires a strict attention to detail, excellent communication, and follow-up skills. The ideal candidate for this role must be very organized, highly motivated, and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist Storeroom Manager with development of purchasing strategy for select MRO categories, including but not limited to considerations of spot buys vs. long-term contracting
* Resolve supplier issues relating to quality, delivery, and pricing
* + Monitor and document vendor performance
* Support management in strategic MRO cost savings projects
* Cooperate with production, maintenance, engineering, and other departments in the development of MRO material requirements, facility services, and indirect spend
* Determine most cost-effective and efficient methods for ordering (e.g., bulk orders)
* Track usage, inventory cost, YOY savings and spend of all indirect materials and services
* Identify alternative vendors or products that meet the specifications (In- Kind Replacement)
* Assist with the creation and compliance of MRO processes within and across departments to provide a reliable storeroom of critical spare parts
* Utilize Reports to trace and monitor Maximo purchase orders (open orders/back orders/late lines), and effectively communicate with the Stores Manager, engineering, maintenance, and production personnel of item availability, order lead-time and order status
* Maintain Maximo files, records and documents related to all purchasing activities including primary and alternate vendor sources, vendor pricing, MFG name/MFG#, drawings, machine information (serial numbers), work order information for future referencing.
* Maintain accurate lead-times and ROP/EOQ for optimal inventory levels, adjust conversion factors and standard costs as required.
* Track and report KPI's: (On-time delivery, service rate, stock out analysis, etc.)
* Process new item setups and commodity code assignments
* Process POs in SAP, receive all purchased items by approving invoices through ARIBA and resolve all invoice conflicts associated with accounts payable
* Assist with cycle count program, processes, and training; perform root-cause analysis, record, and report findings; utilize data for improvement initiatives.
* Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies as required.
* Serve as a primary contact in Central Stores for customer issues or concerns; ensure issues or concerns are resolved quickly and to the customers' satisfaction.
* Work with team members to develop/improve processes for continuous improvement initiatives.
* Works with cross-functional teams (Maintenance Areas) for E&O determination / parts standardization / improvements / new setups / zero balance inventories
* Manage P-Card orders in Maximo and SAP Concur
* Assist with internal customers at the parts counter when required.
* Maintain safety standards and appearance of facility (GMP) as it pertains to their working environment.
* Other Duties as Assigned

**Who you are:**

* Minimum of 5 years MRO Purchasing experience
* Computer literacy, advanced level of Microsoft Excel experience to include pivot table development and other features
* An abili

description:
**Company Description**

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.

At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.

**Job Description**

**Who You’ll Work With**

The Commodity Manager is responsible to develop Arista’s commodity strategies for **Thermal / Heat Sinks** (experience with Front end Power Supplies is a plus) in order to drive time to market, continuity of supply and meet cost reduction initiatives. You'll work across the supply chain to support operations and will be collaborating closely with Engineering on sourcing strategies.

The role will require the individual to be familiar with the complete range of strategic sourcing activities. This includes the analysis of spend, the formulation of and implementation of commodity strategies, the negotiation of contracts and the ongoing management of strategic supplier relationships.

**What You’ll Do**

* Creates, implements, and maintains sourcing strategies for assigned commodities to support company requirements.
* Undertakes spend analysis, supplier assessment and supplier selection to agreed processes.
* Develops and implements commodity strategies in line with company and manufacturing initiatives to improve supply chain efficiencies and reduce the total cost of supply chain management.
* Builds cost models (TAC/should cost) to validate commodity strategies and to understand cost drivers.
* Coordinates all activities with Engineering, NPI, and suppliers to ensure the selection of parts with long lifetimes and solid supply availability.
* Working with the site supply chain leads, this individual will manage relationships with suppliers on behalf of Arista.
* Develops a robust commodity supply base which creates and sustains a competitive advantage for Arista, utilizing global markets, leveraging spend, and best in class technologies.
* Monitors/reports on priority projects and savings.
* Ensures that agreed strategic sourcing targets for cost reduction are met in the commodity portfolio. This includes responsibility for meeting improvement plan targets and year on year cost reductions.
* Provides support to NPI teams as required to meet target costs and establish program cost models.
* Negotiations and management of cost models for suppliers to include "hard" money (such as price, volume discounts, etc.) and "soft" money (such as expertise, technical backup, etc.) in the context of Total Acquisition Cost (TAC) and Total Opportunity Cost (TOC).
* Identification and delivery of opportunities for cost reduction.
* Provides input for annual and long-term savings targets.
* Trains/Mentors junior supply chain personnel on strategic sourcing process.
* Ensures appropriate performance measure (Technology, Quality, Cost and Delivery) of supply base and feedback of results.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations or Engineering required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 10 years’ experience in a networking environment (preferred), electronics or electrical, purchasing, commodity management and materials management positions. CPIM, CIRM, and/or C.P.M. desired.
* Excellent Program and Project Management Skills.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Process Variation Reduction (Six Sigma) concepts and tool sets as they relate to materials management.
* Utilize strong team building abilities to lead cross-functional process improvement teams and lead change within the organization. Ability to coordinate cross-site, multi-functional objectives.
* Ability to interface and positively influence at all levels through excellent communication skills.
* Understanding of assigned commodities, materials, and manufacturing processes.
* Strong PC application skills. Including complement of Microsoft Office Software, with strong capabilities in Project and Access.

**Compensation Information:**

The new hire base pay for this role has a salary range of $142,000 to $188,000.

Arista

Description:

**Job Summary:**

The Buyer is responsible for managing the procurement of assigned materials and services necessary for the company's operations. This involves ensuring the efficient flow of materials within the supply chain, maintaining inventory levels, managing supplier performance, and building strong relationships with suppliers. Effective communication with various departments such as production, receiving, quality, accounting, logistics, and engineering is crucial to fulfill customer orders and meet production needs.

**Essential Functions:**

* Plan and organize assigned purchased materials and services according to product build requirements and MRP recommendations. Experience with Syspro a plus.
* Source assigned materials, components, and services for production and operations, and identify alternate suppliers when current sources cannot meet cost, quality, or delivery requirements.

Who We Are: We're powering a cleaner, brighter future.

Exelon is leading the energy transformation, and we're calling all problem solvers, innovators, community builders and change makers. Work with us to deliver solutions that make our diverse cities and communities stronger, healthier and more resilient.

We're powered by purpose-driven people like you who believe in being inclusive and creative, and value safety, innovation, integrity and community service. We are a Fortune 200 company, 20,000 colleagues strong serving more than 10.7 million customers at six energy companies - Atlantic City Electric (ACE), Baltimore Gas and Electric (BGE), Commonwealth Edison (ComEd), Delmarva Power & Light (DPL), PECO Energy Company (PECO), and Potomac Electric Power Company (Pepco).

We're committed to creating an environment where every person can thrive. Our employee experience is grounded in four tenets that guide how we support our people: purposeful careers, growth opportunities, community impact, and support to thrive.

In our relentless pursuit of excellence, we elevate diverse voices, fresh perspectives and bold thinking. And since we know transforming the future of energy is hard work, we provide competitive compensation, incentives, excellent benefits and the opportunity to build a rewarding career.

Are you in? Primary Purpose:

Implementation of the Supply Chain Process, inventory management, and investment recovery processes and programs.

**Note: This is a hybrid position (in-office with remote flexibility). Employees are required to be in office at least three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). This position must sit out of our Baltimore - MD office. This position is not eligible for relocation assistance.**

Primary Duties:

* Support quality and cost objectives by developing and implementing sourcing strategies that ensure the total cost of materials and services purchased have considerable value and minimal risk. Support and perform activities that successfully implement the Supply Chain Process. Support quality and cost objectives by developing and implementing sourcing strategies that ensure the total cost of materials and services purchased have considerable value and minimize risk.
* Support the implementation of inventory management and investment recovery practices; support the maintenance and analysis of inventory performance measures and the planning and forecasting of inventory levels; and support investment recovery efforts.
* Support Category Managers and perform activities to source, manage, maintain, and implement contracts and purchase orders and the associated databases; and with supplier performance monitoring
* Support and perform day to day process resolution including: un-enterable invoices, supplier changes and adds, unit of measure changes, economies of scale identification and changes. Investigate and correct issues associated with mismatch invoices; contracts, purchase orders, deliveries, shipping, expediting orders, quality, and receiving.
* Support and implement the process that monitors and reports out on supplier performance trends, savings opportunities and achieved, discounts, and settlement agreements.
* Manage and implement the process that controls changes to customer requirements on material requests, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, vendor exceptions, receiving reconciliation, engineering specifications, category IDs, and business unit disputes with the suppliers, deviations from normal Supply processes, and emergent requests.
* Support the Business Units' Emergency Response activities as assigned

Job Scope:

* Support the work plan and outage schedule requirements for material and services requirements.
* Actively participate on change management, commodity strategy and procurement teams representing material availability to ensure compliance to Supply Chain Management operational goals.
* Manage sourcing activities related to the purchase of materials or services.
* Implementation of the Strategic Sourcing objectives and alliance partnerships to ensure consistent quality of material and timely delivery, price savings, and overall supply chain improvements.
* Maintenance of a qualified supplier pool is available.
* Communicates across business units, with Suppliers, and other stakeholders to successfully source and purchase materials and services.
* Oversees the Implementation of supply chain monitoring activities through the use of performance indicators and trend analysis; the mitigation of supply chain risk and the resolution of supply process issue resolution. Oversees the implementation of supplier performance monitoring and associated performance improvement initiatives. Manages complex, high dollar purchasing activities.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Bachelor's Degree in business, engineering, science or related field with 4-7 years' experience or in lieu of degree, 6-9 years of relevant experience.
*

Overview:

We are seeking a full-time **Buyer 1** at Garmin's U.S. headquarters in the Greater Kansas City area. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the acquisition of assigned commodities and products.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Drive performance to meet world-class levels in supplier Quality, Cost, Delivery and Service (QCDS)
* Responsible for supplier development in the areas of supplier partnering agreements and QCDS
* Manage the planning, ordering and delivery of all components, products and services to ensure on-time delivery across all levels of the organization
* Closely monitor inventory levels of assigned commodities and products to maximize inventory turns and minimize exposure to obsolescence
* Review, analyze, develop and negotiate multiple procurement contracts in support of Garmin’s Master Production Schedule (MPS)
* Prepare cost price analysis for various supplier partnering agreements and projects
* Review and compile inventory costing records, such as Purchase Price Variance (PPV), scrap and rework costs
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, and Marketing to develop new sources of supply in support of new product development
* Knowledge of department processes and procedures, work instructions and training requirements for the Purchasing Department in support of ISO9000/QS9000
* Continued improvement to ensure departmental goals and metrics are met

Qualifications:

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a related field **OR** an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, negotiating, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills to work across functional and organizational lines with uncompromising ethics
* Must be a motivated self-starter with a demonstrated proven track record in the ability to prioritize, organize and multi-task in a flexible, fast paced and challenging environment to effectively meet deadlines
* Must possess demonstrated knowledgeable of Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRPII)/Master Production Schedule (MPS) process
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing requirements and ability to asses supplier capabilities
* Demonstrated proficient computer skills using Microsoft Office Word, Excel and PowerPoint

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Management, Operations or Material or equivalent experience
* Certified in Production & Inventory Management (CPIM) or Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM)
* Previous experience in a electronics manufacturing or repair purchasing

*Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.*

*This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here:* *Garmin Benefits*

**Number of Vacancies**

1

**Location**

Edinburg, Texas

**Department**

Procurement Office

**FTE**

1

**FLSA**

Exempt

**Scope of Job**

To provide advanced professional advisory and technical skills necessary in the procurement process to acquire supplies, equipment, and services required by the institution in compliance with all applicable laws, rules, regulation, policies and procedures. Primarily responsible for performing various tasks related to the Procurement Cycle from procurement planning through order fulfillment for complex procurements including institutional master supply/service agreements and licensing and leasing agreements. Assist in the operational planning and administration of an assigned service area(s).

**Description of Duties**

* Administers and directs strategic procurements and discretionary and nondiscretionary competitive bids, including conducting pre-proposal and/or pre-bid conferences, conducting evaluations and determining best value, analyzing supplier responses, creating tabulations and related procurement documentation, and making recommendations for award.
* Prepares, reviews, and analyzes procurement reports to assist with development of procurement management strategies.
* Directly coordinates with appropriate staff, various University departments, UT System (as applicable) and pertinent contractors at all stages of the procurement process to ensure best value is secured in accordance with all applicable State, System, and University procurement regulations, polices, and procedures.
* Provides guidance and support to staff, program managers, principal investigators and faculty in the area of procurement including, but not limited to, reviewing the financial terms and conditions of agreements; ensures appropriateness documents for solicitation, contract renewals, extensions and modifications in accordance with Customer requests and purchasing management.
* Interprets and ensures departmental compliance with federal, state, and local policies including internal UTRGV policies and procedures.
* Prepares statements, reports, projects, estimates, and/or projects as requested.
* Resolves issues/problems that arise with the campus community and/or vendors.
* Functions as an effective liaison between University departments and related contracting entities, and provides direction to University representatives in purchase order negotiations.
* Reviews University spend reports for assigned commodities and identifies potential strategic sourcing initiatives or spend trends and patterns.
* May leads or supports internal teams and task forces, providing functional expertise and guidance on the procurement systems and business processes that may include training purchasing staff as required.
* Maintains supplier and/or supply e-catalogs; creation of and maintenance of item master database records.
* Maximizes usage of contractual item(s) or supplier opportunities; identify possibilities for process improvement, service enhancement and/or cost reductions.
* Reviews and analyzes a range of contracting scopes of work and/or specifications, and researches, redrafts, and develops scope documents as necessary to establish clarity and to secure the best interests of the University; provide direction and leadership to University departments in developing scopes of work/specifications
* Ensures opportunities in university contracts to HUB firms when expected value is of at least $100,000 including commodities, professional services, and construction.
* Coordinates with the Contracts Office and applicable departments on procurement solicitations that will result in formal agreements to ensure appropriate terms are included in the solicitation, and the scope of work will effectively transfer to the agreement; develop resulting agreements.
* Coordinates and oversees purchase order execution and provides University departments with guidance on purchase order administration as necessary
* Promotes and develops end-user understanding of procurement procedures and processes through training and direct interaction; assists with, and conducts if necessary, University procurement training.
* Provides leadership, direction, and training to the different level of financial stakeholders within the university.
* Participates in testing and process validation, and serves on teams responsible for upgrades and enhancements to the ERP system.
* Modifies custom queries utilizing PeopleSoft Query or other reporting tools in collaboration with departmental staff. Prepare queries in response to open records requests and University of Texas (UT) System requests.
* Based on specialized area of assignment, may also perform the following duties:

o Meets with salespeople to review products or service offerings and also serves as a liaison between vendor community and end user departments on product updates.

o Assists in the preparation of statutorily required HUB reports.

Trelleborg leverages in-depth materials and applications expertise with early market insights, making the Group a world leader in engineered polymer solutions. We offer a unique portfolio covering a broad range of applications – even the most complex ones. In 2025, Trelleborg Group reported annual sales of approximately SEK 34 billion, with operations in around 40 countries. The Group comprises three business areas: Trelleborg Industrial Solutions, Trelleborg Medical Solutions, and Trelleborg Sealing Solutions. The Trelleborg share has been listed on the Stock Exchange since 1964 and is traded on Nasdaq Stockholm, Large Cap. [www.trelleborg.com] (https://www.trelleborg.com/)

Make your mark on the future. Accelerate your career with Trelleborg and start shaping industry from the inside.

Take advantage of this rare opportunity to partner with one of the leading contract manufacturers in the world! Leverage your skills in a role where you will be part of process of life-saving medical devices and enjoy the support and stability of an organization that has been in business for over 100 years.

Why join us?

As a valued team member with Trelleborg Medical Solutions, you will enjoy:

* Competitive compensation:
* Generous benefits package: Includes health, dental, vision, STD, LTD, life, 401k, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more!
* Greater opportunity for impact:
* Growth and advancement: Join a global company that loves to promote from within and allows for advancement.
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Bonus potential
* And much more

Trelleborg Medical Solutions is currently accepting applications for a Strategic Sourcing Manager for our Plymouth, Minnesota location. The Strategic Sourcing Manager will be a key part of our global TMS support team and will provide leadership to a team of Buyers supporting manufacturing sites across TMS on purchasing-related matters. In addition to managing and developing the Buyer team, this role will serve as a strategic counterpart for key suppliers and oversee related key raw material categories.

The focus of the Strategic Sourcing Manager is to improve, develop, and implement processes and tools within Purchasing on a global level. Working closely with colleagues from the global support team, site Purchasing professionals, and the Buyer team, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will ensure that purchasing strategies, processes, and best practices are consistently executed across the organization. The role is responsible for identifying and capturing synergy opportunities, supporting the development and performance of the Buyer team, and driving Purchasing Excellence (PE) on both a strategic and operational level.

**Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Spend mapping and analysis – Collection and maintenance of global spend data for nominated commodities
* Develop, maintain and execute a global strategy for nominated commodities
* Development and negotiation of contracts with key suppliers to nominated commodities
* Sourcing projects – support local sites in the identification of opportunities and applying a systematic approach
* Supplier Market development – Attend seminars, network with peers, work with other group purchasing teams to identify new suppliers.
* Identify areas of risk, i.e. monopoly, proprietary materials, customer approvals etc. that limit our choice of supplier.
* Ownership of Business-to-Business meetings with several key suppliers.
* Support TMS Manufacturing sites on PE related supply- and sourcing activities, to ensure stable supply
* Project Management driven approach with clear KPI mindset and time plan focus
* Work with Group Purchasing to drive next steps in Trelleborg digital sourcing journey
* Identify opportunities for, and implement Sourcing initiatives, on Direct- and Indirect Material & Services

**Education and Experience:**

* 4-year degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Procurement or related field.
* 3 years of increasing leadership experience managing purchasing or supply chain professionals.
* 5-7+ years of progressive purchasing, sourcing, supply chain, or procurement experience within a manufacturing environment.
* Completed or working towards professional certifications such as CPSM, CSCP, CPM or equivalent are preferred.
* Proven track record of supplier negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship management with domestic and international suppliers.
* Experience managing strategic supplier relationships.
* Medical device manufacturing or other highly regulated industry experience preferred but not required.

**Competencies:**

* Strong communication skills and strength in initiating and leading conversation
* Business and commercial awareness
* Strong negotiation and influencing skills
* Recognizes and manages conflict effectively
* Problem solving skills
* Flexible and able to cope with ambiguity
* Planning and organizational skills

Salary: $90,000-$110,000

description:
**Working Title:** Strategic Buyer

**Business Function:** Supply Chain

**Reports To:** Senior Manager, Supply Chain

**Job Summary**

The Strategic Buyer owns the commercial relationship and long-term performance of assigned suppliers supporting Hologic's production and indirect requirements, including suppliers that manufacture components unique to Hologic. The role supports sourcing, negotiations, cost reduction, supply risk mitigation, and item master data, and owns supplier on-time delivery (OTD).

This position owns strategic procurement activities and supports tactical execution, bridging the Commodity Manager, who sets category strategy, and the Tactical Buyer, who executes purchase orders. The Strategic Buyer uses independent judgment to resolve material issues.

**Essential Duties**

The candidate may be asked to perform other function-related activities in addition to the responsibilities below, as reasonably required by business needs.

* Lead site sourcing in support of the global sourcing and commodity teams, including spend analysis, business award scenarios, cost models, and RFQs.
* Partner with cross-functional teams across the supplier lifecycle, from evaluation, selection, and onboarding through risk mitigation and offboarding, including dual-sourcing strategies with the global sourcing team.
* Support global sourcing on supply agreement negotiations and monitor contract compliance.
* Drive cost reduction through the VIP pipeline and value engineering. Support the annual standard cost update and own purchase price variance review and material quotes.
* Own supplier OTD and long-term performance through scorecards, supplier reviews, and QBRs, and drive actions that reduce delivery risk and business impact.
* Resolve supplier delivery and quality issues with cross-functional partners, including root cause and corrective action.
* Partner with data governance and cross-functional teams to maintain accurate item master data and strategic ERP parameters, including pricing, lead times, MOQ, safety stock, and sourcing rules. Support new supplier and part number setup, as well as engineering and supplier changes.
* Review demand, MRP signals, inventory, and open POs with Planning and Manufacturing. Share forecasts with suppliers and escalate supply risks.
* Guide Tactical Buyers on PO requirements, transactional exceptions, escalated issues, and end-of-life materials. Process POs as needed.
* Improve inventory turns through programs such as supplier Kanban, and lead continuous improvement and site cross-functional projects.
* Represent Supply Chain on New Product teams and define supply chain strategy for new products.

**Physical Demands**

The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls.
* Stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred, and/or equivalent experience.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of procurement experience; medical device or pharmaceutical industry experience preferred but not required.
* Experience with an ERP system, MRP logic, and item master data; Oracle experience is a plus.

**Skills**

* CPIM, CPSM, CPM, or PMP certification preferred; APICS involvement is a plus.
* Negotiation, cost modeling, and total cost analysis.
* Supplier relationship management, performance management, and risk management, including dual-sourcing strategy with the global sourcing team.
* Working knowledge of a PLM system such as Agile, change control, and quality processes.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, with the ability to build collaborative relationships internally and externally.
* Accurate, dependable, and audit-ready, with experience supporting internal and external audits. Ability to work to tight requirements with minimal supervision and sound escalation judgment.
* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including advanced Excel and data analysis.

**Compensation**

The annualized base salary range for this role is $77,800 to $121,700, and the position is eligible for an annual bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, education, location, business needs, and market conditions.

**Agency and Third-Party Recruiter Notice**

Agencies that submit resumes to Hologic must have a current, fully executed Hologic Agency Agreement approved by the Human Resources Department. Agencies may only submit candidates for positions when specifically authorized to do so by a Hologic Recruiter. Resumes submitted outside of these terms will not be considered.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Hologic is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer inclusive of disability and veterans.

Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

SUMMARY

Support procurement of items such as materials, components, equipment, supplies, and outsourced services that are required for engineering prototype builds and general engineering operations.

Provides analytical and specialized administrative support to relieve executive, director, and/or staff managers of complex details and advanced administrative duties.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Coordinate executives, directors and/or manager’s calendar, meetings, correspondence and presentations as needed.

Coordinate and arrange meetings facilities and records and transcribe minutes of meetings.

Participate or lead special projects and/or events as needed.

Serve as the administrative liaison with others within and outside the company regarding administrative issues relating to purchasing, personnel, facilities and operations.

Plan and prepare for customer visits and corporate events.

Serve as resource to others in the resolution of complex problems and issues.

Issue Purchase Orders to pricing, terms & conditions that are negotiated and agreed to by Jabil Commodity Managers and Buyers. Ensure suppliers’ adherence to established agreements.

Processes purchase requisitions and purchase orders through Coupa.

Optimize order management process to ensure effective communication with suppliers.

Support Accounts Payable in resolving invoice discrepancies.

Handles shipping and receiving packages.

Processes new vendor onboarding using Jabil’s systems.

Perform analysis and reporting of purchase history and supplier performance.

Adheres to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor.

Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy.

May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

MANAGEMENT & SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reports to Sr. Manager of Engineering Operations

Job is NOT directly responsible for managing other employees (e.g., hiring/termination and/or pay decisions, performance management).

JOB QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Typically requires a minimum of 6+ years of related experience.

Or an equivalent combination of education, training or experience.

===============================

You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e-mail to Always\\_Accessible@Jabil.com or calling 727-803-7988 with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e-mail or phone number. **POSITION GOAL**
-----------------

To coordinate, within assigned categories, the professional purchasing of a variety of categories of complex materials, supplies and equipment to support a broad range of diverse instructional and technical school system programs. The position also provides technical guidance to school administrators originating requests to purchase electronic and other specialized equipment and services.

**ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------------------------

The Purchasing Agent IV shall carry out the essential performance responsibilities listed below:

* Supervise staff as assigned in the performance of job duties.
* Write, edit, recommend, and coordinate highly technical product specifications and bid conditions and analyze price comparison with market trends, economy and availability of products to determine the procurement process for obtaining the most suitable product at the lowest and best price for assigned categories.
* Expedite follow-up on all purchase orders within area of assigned responsibility.
* Work with committees of teachers, curriculum planners, principals, and department heads in to formulate and upgrade specifications and evaluation of bids.
* Meet and interact effectively with the general public, staff members, administrators and other contact persons, using tact and good judgment.
* Maintain complete responsibility for the formal bid process in area of assigned commodity responsibility.
* Exercise direct contact with vendors to ensure performance and follow-up on identified discrepancies.
* Purchase materials, supplies, and equipment in areas of assigned responsibility.
* Ensure proper handling of school and department requisitions and secure lowest possible cost for items needed.
* Solicit written and telephone price quotations.
* Assist in the coordination of purchases for all new schools.
* Maintain vendor file in area of assigned commodity responsibility.
* Maintain requisition log in area of assigned responsibility.
* Assign vendor code numbers to purchase requisitions.
* Perform and promote all activities in compliance with the equal employment and nondiscrimination policies of The School Board of Broward County, Florida.
* Participate in training programs offered to enhance the individual skills and proficiency related to job responsibilities.
* Review current developments, literature and technical sources of information related to job responsibilities.
* Ensure adherence to safety rules and procedures.
* Follow federal and state laws, as well as School Board policies.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the immediate supervisor or designee.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**
---------------------------------------

* An earned bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
* A minimum of six (6) years, within the last nine (9) years of experience and/or training in the field related to the title of the position or six (6) years of satisfactory experience in the job assignment of Buyer or Purchasing Agent with The School Board of Broward County, Florida.
* Ability to communicate effectively with a diverse group of requestors and vendors.
* Knowledge and experience in preparing bid specifications in categories of complex technical materials, supplies and equipment of governmental or school system programs.
* Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM), Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM), or equivalent certification from an accredited institution.
* Computer skills as required for the position.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**
-----------------------------------------

* Certified Professional Public Buyer (CPPB), Certified Purchasing Procurement Officer (CPPO), or equivalent certification from an accredited institution and public school procurement experience.
* SAP experience in Procurement Modules.
* Bilingual skills.

**SIGNIFICANT CONTACTS-frequency, contact, purpose**
----------------------------------------------------

Frequently works with District administrators, planners, principals and department heads to gain information to develop bid specifications and obtain customer feedback for performance improvement; frequently works with outside vendors to negotiate contract terms.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------------

Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently as needed to move objects.

**TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT**
-----------------------

Salary and benefits shall be paid consistent with the District's approved compensation plan. Length of the work year and hours of employment shall be those established by the School Board.

**LINK TO JOB DESCRIPTION**
---------------------------

To review the complete job description for this position access the following website: https://www.browardschools.com/Page/36072 and search by Job Code. The Job Code for this position is: DD-078

**The company built on breakthroughs.**
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

The Global Supply Management (GSM) Function is recognized as a critical function for business success. It delivers the training, tools and opportunities needed to create innovative solutions for the function & the corporation. GSM has leading edge, effective processes to anticipate and exceed customer requirements.

**Role Purpose**

Leads the development and execution of Global Supply Management (GSM) Strategic Sourcing strategies, policies, tactics and objectives for assigned complex global commodities that align and are linked with the business units, commercial, supply chain and manufacturing strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

Develops and/or assists with Strategic Sourcing plans and objectives (short & long term) based on forecasts of future demand and taking into account economic and currency trends and conditions that affect GSM, the business, and the global commodity sourced.

* Works with the Business, GSSM, and Buyers on assigned global commodities to prepare and solicit competitive bids, quotations, and proposals with pertinent specifications, terms and conditions.
* Develops and reviews specifications, statements of work, performance terms and accept/reject criteria.
* Conduct negotiations with potential and/or current major suppliers to obtain maximum value.
* Leads the development and communication of global supply intelligence for assigned commodities.
* Owns the Supplier Relationship Management process for the assigned commodities.
* Develops and cultivates effective relationships with suppliers.
* Develop, maintain and execute Shared Objectives and Service Level Agreements.
Champions and advocates for the Global Buying Policy. Ensures compliance

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 8 years+ Experience in manufacturing – operations, planning, engineering, supply management, or procurement.
* Experience in Category or Program Management.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience across multiple businesses, divisions and/or technologies.
* Experience with global manufacturing and business through work or project experience.
* Experience working in a matrix environment or on a cross functional team.

**This position does not support immigration sponsorship.**

The range for this position is $96,534.00 - $132,734.00 assuming full time status. Starting pay for the successful applicant is dependent on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.

**A job that shapes a life.**

Your well-being is our priority. Our compensation and benefits package supports your health and wellness, financial aspirations, and career from day one.

* Company-wide bonuses and long-term incentives align with key business results and ensure you are rewarded when the company performs well. When Corning wins, we all win.
* As part of our commitment to your financial well-being, we provide a 100% company-paid pension benefit with fixed contributions that grow throughout your career. Combined with matching contributions to your 401(k) savings plan, Corning’s total contributions to your retirement accounts can reach between 7% and 12% of your pay, depending on your age and years of service.
* Our health and well-being benefits include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, family building support, fitness, company-paid life insurance, disability, disease management programs, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to support you and your family.
* Getting paid for our work is important, but feeling appreciated and recognized for those contributions motivates us much more. That’s why Corning offers a recognition program to celebrate successes and reward colleagues who make exceptional contributions.

We prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected status.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Purchasing Manager to be accountable for the full procurement function: ensuring electronic components and materials are sourced, purchased, and delivered on time and on cost to support PCBA production across Avalir's aerospace/defense, space, and medical programs. This role partners closely with Engineering, Planning, Quality, Receiving, Program Management, and executive leadership, and serves as the escalation point for supplier performance, material shortages, and customer commitments. The Purchasing Manager reports to the Director of Supply Chain and regularly contributes purchasing performance data, including purchase price variance for executive-level review.

**About Avalir**

Avalir (formerly Electronic Source Company) is a leading electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider, delivering quick-response, high-reliability printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) built on world-class manufacturing equipment, practices, and technology. The assemblies Avalir builds support mission-critical end products, from missile guidance to satellite systems, for industry-leading customers. Avalir's business is approximately 70% aerospace & defense, 25% space, and 5% medical, reflecting a customer base that demands the highest standards of quality, traceability, and on-time delivery.

**ITAR Notice**

This position supports programs subject to ITAR and EAR export control regulations. Candidates must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

**Reports To**

Director of Supply Chain, with regular visibility and reporting to executive leadership on purchasing performance, cost, and purchase price variance (PPV).

**Direct Reports**

* Senior Buyers
* Buyers
* MRO Buyer

The team is based in Chatsworth, CA and includes remote team members on the East Coast. The team is expected to grow as the business scales, and the Purchasing Manager will lead its structure, recruitment, and development.

**Key Working Relationships**

Internal: Supply Chain leadership, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, Estimating/Quoting, Receiving, Stockroom, Document Control, Finance, and Operations. External: component manufacturers, franchised distributors, brokers (under counterfeit-mitigation controls), contract service providers, and customers.

**THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

This is an opportunity for a hands-on purchasing leader to help develop, shape, and grow Avalir’s purchasing and supply chain function. We are looking for someone who wants to build, not just maintain, and who takes real pride in developing the people around them.

* **Proactive and driven –** Takes ownership, anticipates supply risks and problems before they reach the production floor, and acts without waiting to be asked. Brings energy, urgency, and a strong sense of accountability for results.
* **A builder –** Excited by the chance to develop, shape, and grow the purchasing and supply chain function, putting in place the processes, systems, structure, and talent needed to scale with the business.
* **Collaborative –** Builds strong, trusted relationships across Engineering, Planning, Quality, Program Management, and Operations, as well as with suppliers and customers. Sees supply chain as a team effort and works to find solutions rather than assign blame.
* **A coach, mentor, and developer of people –** Genuinely invested in growing others; able to coach, mentor, and develop buyers into stronger professionals and future leaders as the function expands.
* **Hands-on and grounded –** Comfortable rolling up their sleeves on day-to-day buying, expediting, and supplier issues when needed, while keeping sight of the bigger strategic picture.
* **A continuous improver –** Curious, data-driven, and always looking for a better way to work, whether in process, systems, supplier strategy, or team capability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Senior Buyers, Buyers, and the MRO Buyer, including remote team members on the East Coast; set goals, conduct performance reviews, and manage individual development plans
* Recruit and onboard talent as the team grows; define team structure, roles, account and commodity coverage, backup, and succession planning to scale the function

**Procurement Operations**

* Ensure components are sourced and purchased accurately and on time to customer BOMs, build schedules, and committed ship dates; oversee PO creation, approval, backlog, acknowledgements, and expediting/de-expediting in Epicor Kinetic ERP
* Drive proactive resolution of component shortages through expedites, alternates, and substitutions, and maintain accurate ERP purchasing data (item master, approved manufacturers, pricing, lead times) so MRP output can be relied on
* Support Estimating/Quoting with accurate component pricing, lead times, and availability for customer RFQs

**Cost, Inventory & Financial Performance**

* Own
