**Buyer**

Location: Plymouth, MI
Company: Optimal-EV
Employment Type: Full-Time
Start: Immediate / ASAP

**About Optimal-EV**

Optimal-EV is an innovative electric vehicle manufacturer focused on developing and producing next-generation electric shuttle buses and mobility solutions. We are seeking an experienced Buyer to join our team in Plymouth, Michigan and support our growing manufacturing and purchasing operations.

**Position Summary**

The Buyer will be responsible for purchasing a broad range of materials, components, parts, and services required to support Optimal-EV's manufacturing and engineering operations.

The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years of purchasing experience in an automotive supplier, manufacturing, or small-to-mid-sized business environment. We are particularly interested in candidates who have broad purchasing experience and have been involved with multiple types of materials, components, suppliers, and purchasing activities.

Experience with NetSuite is preferred but not required.

**Key Responsibilities**

Manage day-to-day purchasing activities for production, engineering, and operational requirements.

Purchase a variety of materials, components, parts, and services needed to support manufacturing operations.

Create and manage purchase orders, ensuring accurate pricing, quantities, specifications, and delivery requirements.

Identify and evaluate suppliers based on cost, quality, delivery, and capability.

Request and evaluate supplier quotes and negotiate pricing, lead times, and commercial terms.

Communicate directly with suppliers regarding pricing, availability, delivery schedules, quality concerns, and other purchasing matters.

Monitor open purchase orders and proactively address late or delayed deliveries.

Work closely with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to understand material requirements, specifications, and timing.

Review BOMs, part numbers, material requirements, and other purchasing information.

Coordinate with suppliers to ensure materials are available when needed to support production schedules.

Partner with Quality and suppliers to resolve material and supplier-related issues.

Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, and purchase order data.

Support supplier onboarding and maintain strong supplier relationships.

Monitor material availability and help prevent production shortages.

Identify opportunities for cost savings and improved purchasing efficiency.

Support inventory and material planning activities.

Assist with developing and maintaining supplier performance metrics.

Ensure purchasing activities follow company policies and established processes.

Take ownership of purchasing issues and drive them through resolution.

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.

Minimum of 5 years of purchasing, buying, procurement, or related experience.

Experience working in an automotive supplier, manufacturing company, or small-to-mid-sized business environment.

Strong understanding of purchasing processes, supplier management, purchase orders, pricing, lead times, and material requirements.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple purchasing categories, suppliers, and components.

Strong negotiation, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of purchasing activities.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience with NetSuite or another ERP/MRP system.

Automotive manufacturing or automotive supplier experience.

Experience purchasing a broad range of mechanical, electrical, fabricated, machined, or other manufacturing components.

Experience working with engineering drawings, BOMs, part numbers, and material specifications.

Experience with supplier cost negotiations and cost-reduction initiatives.

Experience supporting new product development or production launches.

Knowledge of EV manufacturing and/or electric vehicle components is a plus.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a hands-on Buyer who has broad exposure to purchasing and understands how purchasing decisions directly impact manufacturing operations.

Candidates coming from automotive suppliers, contract manufacturers, or small-to-mid-sized manufacturing companies are strongly preferred because these environments typically provide broader exposure to different commodities, suppliers, components, and purchasing activities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable wearing multiple hats, working directly with suppliers, supporting Engineering and Manufacturing, resolving material shortages, negotiating pricing, and taking ownership from purchase order placement through delivery.

**Hiring Timeline**

description:
At Midrex, you will do work that matters alongside people who believe you matter. The work won’t be easy, but it will be worth it. You’ll be part of a great team—with plenty of autonomy—to bring out your best. And you’ll be well compensated and have a best-in-class benefits package. Take a look:

* Competitive benefits effective from Day 1

* Dollar-for-dollar 401(k) matching (up to 6%)

* Profit sharing with 401(k) kicker

* Generous overtime for qualified positions

* 4 weeks of paid vacation

* Tuition reimbursement

* Raffles for professional sports tickets

* Half-day Fridays

* Flexible home/office work practices

* Paid time to volunteer

* Employee recognition awards

Since 1987, Midrex has been the world leader in direct reduction technology, offering the best proven method for decarbonization in the iron and steel industry available today. Our rapid growth is transforming the steel industry and our planet. And none of it would be possible without our people, who bring vision, compassion, and extraordinary expertise to this work every day. So, if you’re looking to do big work in a small-team environment, Midrex is just the place for you.

The Junior Buyer / Expeditor provides purchasing and expediting support for industrial machinery and materials for domestic and international projects. Duties frequently require negotiation to achieve results.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Review requisitions for completeness, issue inquiries to qualified vendors, and coordinate technical reviews
* Analyze vendor quotations for compliance with requisition requirements. Develop relationships with vendors to obtain favorable delivery, schedule, price, and commercial terms and conditions
* Place purchase orders for technical items and large volume commodity items in coordination with project schedules utilizing current ERP and MRP systems.
* Provide frequent, timely and results-oriented vendor expediting to verify and influence manufacturing schedules, shipping schedules or drawing/document submittal schedules.
* Utilize the ERP System as it relates to the Project Procurement Department's expediting functions (i.e. update all salient schedule milestones for material acquisition, manufacturing progress, shipping schedule/actual, etc.).
* Utilize the file sharing and MRP System in all aspects as they relate to the Project Procurement Department's expediting functions.
* Monthly maintenance of the Estimate to Complete (ETC) Spread Sheet for multiple projects that lists anticipated vendor billings and anticipated revenues from clients.
* Liaise with either/both Midrex Global Logistics and the clients' designated freight forwarders to effect shipments.
* Establish and keep current the individual Purchase Order files within the ERP System regarding expediting matters.
* Attend the weekly shipping meetings and utilize the information gained to update the ETC's per project.
* Establish lines of contact with Midrex site management to ensure that all field purchase orders are accurate

**Skills/Abilities:**

Required:

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to learn and take on new responsibility
* Organized with attention to detail
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or related software
* Ability to build relationships with all levels of suppliers' staff and Company teammates

Preferred:

* Experience in an industrial work environment or internship
* Working knowledge of ISO related requirements
* Proficient with a typical ERP system
* Proficient with a typical MRP document control systems

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma, post-high school or Bachelor of Science / Bachelor of Arts Degree preferred in Engineering or Business Administration

**Travel Requirements:**

* 0% - 10% International and Domestic based on project demands

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Ability to move around a project site, including climbing structures.

**Other Duties:**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Midrex is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable laws. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Midrex will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the People and Culture department.

Join Parker’s Filtration Group and be part of a global team driving innovative filtration solutions that protect people, equipment, and the environment across diverse industries. Experience a dynamic, collaborative culture where your ideas fuel progress and your work makes a meaningful impact on sustainability and technological excellence.

**Position Summary**

The Buyer is responsible for commodities or assignments requiring application of basic purchasing principles, theories and concepts. The Buyer ensures timely acquisitions of product or service from known sources of supply. Additionally, the Buyer may resolve issues in the areas of requisition accuracy and completeness, on-time delivery or supplier payment functioning in a closely supervised environment

Scope/ Supervision and Interaction:

Position directly reports to the Sourcing/Commodity Manager.

Essential Functions:

Identifies and recommends suppliers by investigating potential suppliers, researching parts, equipment, machinery, services, and materials availability.

Conducts supplier site visits and evaluates them as to production capability, performance, delivery, and other key business criteria. May complete supplier certification as part of a technical and/or quality team.

Purchases parts, equipment, and materials by preparing request for quotations and submitting purchase orders with approved suppliers. Issues purchase orders and agreements that accurately reflect price, schedule, terms, and conditions as negotiated with suppliers. Maintains accurate lead times for assigned commodities.

Evaluates bids for standard and non-standard items. Selects suppliers for lower cost items or items of limited scope and complexity and negotiates price, delivery, quality and service. Develops alternate sources of supply by identifying and researching prospective suppliers.

Monitors and evaluates supplier performance. Advises appropriate personnel of impending supplier failure to fulfill contractual agreements that may delay production or delivery.

Resolves shipment quality discrepancies by mediating supplier/manufacturing issues. Facilitates the resolution of issues by arranging and participating in conferences between suppliers and company personnel.

Negotiates and settles damage claims, rejections, losses, return of materials, over-shipments, cancellations and engineering changes with suppliers.7. Provides parts, equipment, and materials information by answering questions and requests. Prepares reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends.

Participates in continuous improvement activities and provides suggestions for cost reduction and improved efficiency.

Complies with federal, state, and aerospace industry regulations; ensures adherence to requirements and advises management on needed actions. Complies with Government/Commercial Practices Manual (GPM/CPM) policies and procedures.

Qualifications:

4 year college degree Supply Chain management or relevant discipline.

* Experience and/or exposure to supply chain concepts and methodologies, and manufacturing through internships or training programs.

* Possess analytical and technical skills required to understand business practices and recommend proper automation opportunities.

* Must have intermediate computer skills and be able to understand of electronic processing.

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills for effective interface with all internal and external contacts.

**Starting Compensation:**

$44,967.00/Annually

Find job security and stability alongside a growing community and a team that supports you. Level up your career through a large network and specialty training.

If you're passionate about making a difference, apply today to join us in serving the community!

**Job Description:**

**JOB SUMMARY**

* This full time position, reporting to the Deputy Director of Purchasing, perform purchasing and administrative duties within the Purchasing Department providing support to one or more Buyer II or III positions involving: requisitions and purchase order processing; small & informal purchases with purchasing card; document preparation, including complex solicitations and contract correspondence; contract management; files management; office management; data entry into Workday Purchasing System; and perform other duties as assigned.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Manage daily operations of the Purchasing Office to prevent and/or resolve operational issues.
* Contribute to establishment of standards and procedures for administering the Purchasing Office.
* Research product and pricing needs as directed by assigned Buyer.
* Make small and informal purchases with purchasing card, including travel arrangements.
* Create maintain and manage both manual and automated purchasing files.
* Serve as a liaison with a select number of assigned County departments.
* Provide administrative support for preparation of competitive bids or negotiations of contracts.
* Place bid advertisements in local newspapers of record and online sources.
* Assist in administering awarded commodity contracts (including but not limited to office supplies, cell phones, copiers, vehicles, fleet fuel cards, EZ pass).
* Preparation of analytical reports and invoices.
* Provide technical assistance to County user personnel of the automated purchasing system.
* Assist County personnel to resolve purchasing related problems.
* Resolve any pricing discrepancies on Purchase Orders with Controller's office.
* Advise the Director and/or Deputy Director of Purchasing of any issues affecting the County or the County departments.
* Participate where assigned by the Director on committees or special projects.
* Develop a working knowledge of contracts available for County procurement.
* Assist with mailroom operations, as needed.
* Perform all other duties, tasks, and special projects related to position as required.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Completion of a standard high school course supplemented with experience in a purchasing environment or high school or college courses in business, finance, marketing, accounting, logistics, transportation or related field or any equivalent combination of education and experience which provides the required knowledge, experience, skills and abilities.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Strong professional ethics
* Ability to follow office protocols and County procurement code
* Ability to handle and resolve problems in a timely manner
* Ability to work independently and remain focused on task
* Accurate and detail oriented
* Excellent organizational skills
* Able to carry tasks to completion
* Strong interpersonal skills
* General knowledge and understanding of the procurement process
* Ability to use Microsoft Office Suite, familiar with spreadsheets
* Ability to multi-task and revise priorities, based on changing deadlines and demands
* Discretion in the handling of confidential information

**REQUIRED LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS/CLEARANCES**

* Pre-Employment Background and Reference Check

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk and talk and listen.
* Occasionally the employee will be required to travel by car to other county locations for meetings.
* Occasionally the employee will need to lift 50 lbs or less. This is "mainly" a desk position using a computer and phone to communicate.

The County also observes all applicable laws regarding Veterans status. The County reflects this action in all areas of employment and compensation practices and policies. Employment with the County is based upon the ability to perform the job as well as dependability and reliability once an individual is hired.

The Purchasing Coordinator provides administrative support for the team of commodity purchasers. The primary focus of this role is to streamline the function of the commodity buyers, while enabling a high level of communication with the yards, vendors, and salespeople.

The optimal Purchasing Coordinator is someone with above-average organizational skills, is detail oriented, highly accurate, and able to complete tasks accurately with minimal supervision. This role is vital to fulfilling our mission of Legendary Service Through Teamwork because a highly effective purchasing department is critical to the company being able to deliver on our customer service promises – as well as being critical to the profitability of PARR.

* Knowledge of lumber, panels, and related products
* Knowledge of doors and millwork production *required*
* Proficiency in Word, Excel, and Outlook
* Must be able to operate personal computer, telephone, scanner, and any other equipment necessary for the job
* Ability to speak, write, and read English *required*
* One to two years of related experience; or equivalent combination of experience and/or training
* Knowledge and experience working with perpetual inventory systems *preferred*
* Working knowledge of Biztrack software *preferred*

* Track and follow up on late shipments
* Communicate with the field about late shipments

* Assist Buyers in documenting and following up on product claims
* Standardize, organize, and maintain the department filing systems
* Perform other related duties as assigned

The primary working conditions are an office environment with a computer. The job may require occasional work in lumberyard working to train employees. The job may require occasional travel to PARR locations in the Northwest.

* Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods of time

**What we do here changes the world.** UTHealth Houston is Texas’ resource for healthcare education, innovation, scientific discovery, and excellence in patient care. That’s where you come in.

**The Buyer I s****upports procurement operations by processing requisitions for goods and services, sourcing and evaluating vendors, and managing purchase orders. Ensures compliance with purchasing policies and procedures, administers departmental Procurement Card activities, handles receiving and delivery functions, maintains audit documentation, prepares purchasing reports, and provides customer support throughout the procurement process.**

**Once you join us you won't want to leave.** It’s because we reward our team for the excellent service they provide. Our total rewards package includes the benefits you’d expect from a top healthcare organization (benefits, insurance, etc.), plus:

* 100% paid medical premiums for our full-time employees
* Generous time off (holidays, preventative leave day, both vacation and sick time – all of which equates to around 37-38 days per year)
* The longer you stay, the more vacation you’ll accrue!
* Longevity Pay (Monthly payments after two years of service)
* Build your future with our awesome retirement/pension plan!

**We take care of our employees!** As a world-renowned institution, our employees’ wellbeing is important to us. We offer work/life services such as...

* Free financial and legal counseling
* Free mental health counseling services
* Gym membership discounts and access to wellness programs
* Other employee discounts including entertainment, car rentals, cell phones, etc.
* Resources for child and elder care
* Plus many more!

**Position Summary:**

Prepares and executes requisitions for various, commodities and services under guidelines established by federal, state, and local requirements.

**Position Key Accountabilities:**

* Executes requisitions of goods and services from suppliers.
* Researches and evaluates vendor quotes to qualify commodity suppliers. Identifies qualified suppliers of commodities pursuant to agency needs.
* Monitors and reports purchase order status through the use of various automated systems.
* Interacts regularly with customers to ensure all purchasing policies and procedures are followed.
* Administers University Procurement Card within the assigned department(s) to include; placing orders, reconciliation of orders and adherence to Procurement Card policy and procedures.
* Performs receiving function for desk top delivery within assigned department(s).
* Maintains appropriate documentation for audit purposes.
* Prepares reports on a routine and ad-hoc basis to provide information regarding purchase order activities.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**Certification/Skills:**

* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
* Microsoft Office literate.
* Manages Human Resources activities of department in regards to: recruiting and selection, hiring and termination, training, professional development, mentoring, counseling, performance evaluations, and salary planning.
* Basic Texas Purchaser by Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts preferred

**Minimum Education:**

High School Diploma or equivalent required

**Minimum Experience:**

1 year of buying experience preferred in Higher Education or State of Texas Institution preferred May substitute required experience with equivalent years of education beyond the minimum education requirement.

**Physical Requirements:**

Exerts up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or up to 10 pounds frequently and/or a negligible amount constantly to move objects.

**Security Sensitive:**

This position is a security-sensitive position pursuant to Texas Education Code §51.215 and Texas Government Code §411.094. To the extent that a position requires the holder to research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure as defined in Texas Business and Commerce Code §117.001(2), the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure is a minimum qualification to be hired for and to continue to be employed in that position. Personnel in such positions, and similarly situated state contractors, will be routinely reviewed to determine whether things such as criminal history or continuous connections to the government or political apparatus of a foreign adversary might prevent the applicant, employee, or contractor from being able to maintain the security or integrity of the infrastructure. A foreign adversary is a nation listed in 15 C.F.R. §791.4.

**Residency Requirement:**

Employees must permanently reside and work in the State of Texas.

Description:

**Join the Team at Hubbard Supplyhouse!**

Hubbard Supplyhouse is seeking an energetic, self-motivated individual to join our family-like atmosphere. We are a plumbing and irrigation supply house that also specializes in kitchen, bath, appliances, and lighting. We proudly serve local plumbers, builders, and homeowners in bringing beautiful and functional living spaces to life. As a family-owned, Christian company, our Core Focus (Mission Statement) is **“Honoring God with a great team that builds customer partnerships by delivering on expectations”.** Our team is built on trust, service, and a commitment to doing things the right way.

The Purchasing Agent (Buyer – Inventory Replenishment) supports company success by managing inventory replenishment for a group of our highest-volume plumbing product lines, including water heaters, fixtures and china, pumps, and commodity pipe and fittings. This role is responsible for purchasing inventory for all branch locations and our distribution center while maintaining product availability, healthy inventory turns, and accurate, up-to-date purchase orders. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and analytical, with strong attention to detail and the ability to effectively manage a high-volume purchasing workload. They thrive in a team-first environment and bring strong communication, problem-solving, and technology skills to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external vendor partners.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage assigned buy lines in Epicor Eclipse so stocked items stay in stock at every branch.
* Keep a clean and current book of open purchase orders: follow up with vendors so every open PO carries an accurate date, quantity and cost.
* Work the procurement queue so special-order material is ordered on time.
* Maintain product data in Eclipse: minimums, order points, lead times, and replacement cost that matches the PO.
* Track vendor lead times and order ahead on long lead-time lines so stock arrives before it is needed.
* Use vendor promotions and buy-ins when they fit the inventory plan.
* Use vendor stock rotations to keep inventory clean and non-moving SKUs to a minimum.
* Support the purchasing team by providing coverage for assigned product lines when team members are out.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Maintain strong product availability across assigned “A” and “B” ranked items.
* Keep open purchase orders accurate, current, and well-managed.
* Maintain healthy inventory turns and GMROI across assigned product lines.
* Ensure purchase order costs align with replacement costs.

**What We Offer:**

* Monday–Friday schedule (no nights or weekends)
* Matching 401(k) and profit-sharing program
* Comprehensive benefits package with supplemental options
* Paid holidays, PTO, and sick leave
* Christmas bonus, team-building events and company picnic
* Employee discount program
* Career advancement and ongoing training opportunities

**Ready to be part of a team that values your contributions and helps customers build beautiful, functional spaces?**

**Apply today and grow with Hubbard Supplyhouse!**

Requirements:

**Minimum Requirements**

* 3+ years of purchasing or inventory replenishment experience in wholesale distribution.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with an ERP system.
* Working knowledge of inventory turns, days of inventory, GMROI, lead times, and safety stock.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high-volume workload, and follow through.
* Confident communicating and following up with vendors.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with **Epicor Eclipse**.
* Plumbing, PVF, water heater, or related product knowledge.
* Demonstrated interest in growing responsibilities and expanding your impact within a purchasing department.

Employment type: Employee

Place of work: Hybrid

Offshore/Onshore: Onshore

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

Hiring an experienced Buyer to join the Schilling Robotics team in Davis, CA! This role is responsible for the procurement of materials to achieve the production schedule and support new product and supplier development as needed. Main function is to issue P.O. per demand in the ERP system, follow up on open orders, and resolve quality issues (RTV as needed). Key deliverables insure parts meet specifications, meet on-time delivery and competitive pricing. This position will interact with all Departments within the Company, vendors and Subject Matter Experts to ensure that the Schilling Robotics Supply Chain meets Customer requirement. This position may on occasion support indirect spend categories in addition to production materials and tools. Building effective supplier relationships is critical to the success of the business.

**Salary:** $74,900 - $139,100

### **Description**

The role of the Buyer is to price, quote, and purchase any required materials for the installation of fire protection systems that are currently not produced by the Company. The position analyzes cost, quality, and delivery to ensure competitive performance that is consistent with the organization’s policies and standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Receives quote requests from Customer Service Representatives in an assigned territory for required materials
* Analyzes quotes and negotiates prices and terms with suppliers to obtain competitive sources with respect to cost, quality, delivery and service
* Updates weekly meetings with order and quote totals from the previous week
* Follows up on orders placed with vendors
* Analyzes and reviews stock orders for proper quantities prior to placement
* Procures tracking on all stock orders and drop shipments placed
* Assists in maintaining inventory accuracy by removing C-items and obtaining RMA’s
* Maintains weekly quote logs on all inquiries and reports the breakdown
* Analyzes and reviews the SAC102 report before placing all stock orders with vendors
* Reports all discrepancies and/or issues to the vendors in a timely manner and follows up as needed
* Reviews weekly backorder reports from vendors and expedites shipping to the warehouse
* Promote a safe workplace by performing all tasks in a safe and thoughtful manner in compliance with all rules, procedures, instructions, devices, equipment and use of appropriate personal protective equipment. Maintain vigilance for any hazardous conditions or practices in the workplace and immediately report any unsafe condition or practice to your supervisor.
* Performs other duties as directed

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* Creates an atmosphere in which timely and high quality communication flows smoothly
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Outstanding customer service and negotiation skills
* Excellent time management and organization ability
* Outstanding attention to detail and accuracy
* Works systematically and logically to resolve problems
* Solid understanding of common business practices relating to purchasing, pricing, terms, shipment, taxes and payment for products and services
* Working knowledge of the terminology of the fire protection industry
* Familiar with markets and commodities/component types related to fire protection systems
* Strong technical knowledge of company products
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, DRP, Elite, Dynamics 365
* High School Diploma
* 2 + years in Purchasing, Supply Chain, Logistics, and/or Related Field

### **Job Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and FSA are available after 30 days of employment
* 401k with company match is available after 90 days of employment
* Company-provided Life Insurance is provided for you after 90 days of employment
* 3 PTO days after 60 days of employment (hourly and non-exempt positions only)
* 2 weeks of vacation after 6 months of employment
* 10 paid holidays - including your birthday!
* Paid weekly

### **About Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation**

Bringing together more than 175 years of innovation, quality, and customer commitment under one name and one promise.

The company was forged in 1850, as American industry was being connected by pipe, valves, fittings, and the skilled people who knew how to put them in the right place. More than 175 years later, that heritage lives in ASC Engineered Solutions, a comprehensive pipe preparation, joining, hanging and flow-management portfolio supporting the people who build and maintain commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, and critical systems. A house of brands, Anvil, Gruvlok, Sharpe, SCI, and ABZ, unified as ASC in 2019, and the portfolio has grown in the years since.

In 1920, Reliable Automatic Sprinkler started doing one thing exceptionally well: building the fire safety systems that protect people and property. Sprinklers, valves, and accessories, made in the United States. More than a century later, the discipline has not changed. A century of American-made fire protection products, with multi-generational customer relationships and multi-decade specifications. A century of protecting what matters the most.

**Two legacies. One Future.**

\\*Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.\\*

**Buyer**

The Buyer is responsible for procuring products within assigned planner codes in a timely and cost-effective manner. This role will lead initiatives and projects to resolve quality and delivery concerns to take proactive steps to eliminate or reduce risk to the company.

**Who are we?**

Founded in 1849, Ducommun is the oldest company in California. Starting as a hardware supply store during the California Gold Rush and eventually assisted in the birth of the aerospace industry in Southern California by providing aircraft aluminum to early aerospace pioneers like Lindbergh, Douglas and Lockheed.

Today Ducommun is a global provider of innovative manufacturing solutions for customers in the aerospace, defense and industrial markets. We specialize in electronic and structural systems, producing complex products and components for commercial aircraft platforms, mission-critical military and space programs, and sophisticated industrial applications.

Our Facility in Appleton, WI manufactures state-of-the-art circuit boards for Aerospace and Defense as well as Industrial and Medical Industries.

**Job Summary**

* Negotiate best value with suppliers
* Perform materials quotation for prices and delivery
* Procure products within assigned commodity areas in a timely and cost effective manner
* Identify and reduce long lead times in the system by utilizing material strategies with suppliers
* Review daily MRP exception message, purchase order status, and order action reports and take appropriate action
* Must know when/where to buy goods and services
* Resolve material price variances
* Identify alternate solutions for obsolete components and work with engineering for approval
* Ensure timely delivery of products to support manufacturing
* Develop new/better/alternate sources of supply to reduce the supplier base
* Maintain purchasing data in computer system so that it is always current
* Resolve problems that occur periodically with suppliers
* Maintain appropriate lead times, minimums and multiples; vendor information for all assigned parts in the system
* Performs other assignments as required

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Understanding of engineering drawings and flow charts
* MRP exposure required
* Intermediate level of computer skills in e-mail, internet, Word, and Excel
* Strong communications and interpersonal skills needed
* Experience dealing with suppliers including quoting, order processing and tracking delivery and quality performance

**Preferred Experience and Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred
* 1-5 years relevant purchasing experience required in a manufacturing environment preferred

**Commodity Buyer****-Indirect**

**Autocar, LLC**

**Location Birmingham, AL**

Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for supplier relationships, cost optimization, and supply chain excellence? Join **Autocar**, one of the most respected names in the vocational truck industry and play a key role in shaping the future of our supply chain.

As a **Commodity Buyer****-Indirect**, you will be part of a dynamic and collaborative supply chain team responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key commodities. This role offers the opportunity to work cross-functionally with engineering, supplier development, manufacturing, and supplier partners to drive quality, innovation, cost savings, and operational excellence.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will:

* Perform daily procurement activities supporting prototype, development, and production requirements
* Manage logistics, quality, and financial interactions with suppliers
* Develop, negotiate, and implement commodity strategies that improve supplier performance and maximize value
* Lead supplier negotiations and establish supply agreements aligned with business objectives
* Contribute technical and commercial roadmaps while actively participating in the Autocar buyer network
* Drive initiatives focused on Quality, Delivery, Cost, Project Management, and Risk Mitigation
* Partner with Engineering and Supplier Development teams to identify, monitor, and mitigate supply chain risks
* Forecast cost trends and identify opportunities for cost reduction and continuous improvement
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure supply chain success

**What You Bring**

We are looking for candidates who will demonstrate:

* A collaborative mindset and desire to work toward a common purpose
* Strategic thinking with the ability to understand both internal and external market dynamics
* Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment
* Strong communication and influencing skills
* Analytical problem-solving abilities with a systematic approach
* Process-driven decision making and execution
* High integrity and commitment to doing what is right
* The ability to build lasting supplier and stakeholder relationships

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred

**Experience**

* 2+ years of purchasing or buyer experience preferred
* Recent engineering graduates with a strong interest in supply chain and procurement are encouraged to apply
* Automotive or commercial vehicle industry experience is a plus
* Experience working in complex supply chain environments preferred

**Skills**

description:
We are Doe Run – 160 years strong, delivering minerals and metals to power the world.

The Doe Run Company is seeking a Buyer to support operations by timely sourcing and ordering material, equipment, and services while supporting financial, quality and expedited needs. This position is located at our Central Office in Viburnum, MO.

The work location may change as needed to support production and business needs within the Viburnum Trend in Southeast Missouri.

Based in St. Louis, Missouri, The Doe Run Company is a privately held natural resources company and one of the largest lead producers in the Western Hemisphere. Dedicated to environmentally responsible mineral and metal production, Doe Run has facilities in Missouri, Washington, and Arizona and operates one of the world's largest, single-site lead recycling facilities, located in Boss, MO. Using innovative mining techniques, Doe Run skillfully taps one of the largest lead deposits in the world. As stewards of the mineral resources in our care, we strive to provide premium services and products to people who share our belief in enhancing the quality of life. You may view our sustainability report located at http://sustainability.doerun.com/.

We Offer:

Competitive base pay plus bonus eligible.
Benefits start day 1, including insurance, paid time off, and discount programs.

Career growth opportunity, plus training and education assistance.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Purchasing: Source material, equipment and services for the organization as needed. Negotiate with vendors for price, availability, quality and delivery time. Manage backorder report and invoice exceptions regularly to ensure material is received and invoices are paid in a timely manner.
* Customer relations: Work with internal customers to ensure the correct material, equipment and services are quoted, ordered and received in a timely manner.
* Vendor relations: Work with vendors to ensure material, equipment and services are rendered at the best overall cost and received in a timely manner.
* Commodity analysis: Perform analysis on commodities purchased including sourcing and engaging with vendor base.
* Complete tasks in a safe and environmentally compliant manner by following EHS (environmental, health and safety) policies, procedures and best practices; support and assist peers in working in a safe, compliant manner; report unsafe acts or conditions, incidents, and deviations; and provide feedback to support continuous improvement in EHS performance.
* Other duties or projects as assigned.

**Education & Experience:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum 3 years customer relations/service experience.
* 1 year of buying experience preferred.
* Associate degree preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:**

* Proficient computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite, ERP enterprise resource planning (PeopleSoft) and accounts payable (DataServ).
* Proficient decision-making regarding prioritization and negotiation.
* Advanced customer relations and communication skills (including verbal, written, and listening).
* Attention to detail must be detail-oriented and maintain the ability to manage multiple tasks.

**Environmental Conditions, Physical & Lifting Requirements:**

* Regular use of a computer and telephone,
* Work is regularly performed in a quiet office setting.
* Regularly sitting, talking, hearing, reach with hands/arms, and repetitive wrist and/or finger movements. Requires clarity of vision at 20 inches or less.
* Occasionally required to lift up to 5 pounds.

All job offers are contingent upon the candidate's successful completion and clearance of post-offer drug screen, physical, and background check. Background checks include verification of education, employment history, and criminal record review. The role may also require a motor vehicle record review and ATF explosives possessor clearance.

Doe Run is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and veterans.

#### **Experience**

Required

* 3 year(s): Customer relations/service experience.

Preferred

* 1 year(s): Buying experience.

#### **Education**

Required

* High School or better

Preferred

* Associates or better

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

**Pay: Starting at $85K**

**Location: Dallas, TX**

**Meat knowledge a must**

\\*\\*Position Summary: \\*\\*Coordinates inventory replenishment activities with suppliers, sales, logistics and operations for assigned categories.

**What you’ll do:**

* Place purchase orders with vendors utilizing an awareness of seasonal fluctuations, market effects and other information that require a high attention to detail to avoid spoilage, overstocks, and shortages.
* Manage and maintain the entire Purchase-to-Pay process, covering:- PO Creation

+ Vendor Confirmation
+ Accurate expected delivery date updates
+ Collaboration with Accounts Payable to ensure payment.
* Maintain Purchasing system data to effectively generate suggested POs.

+ Logistics to minimize freight expenses.
+ Sales Managers to manage out-of-stock or over-stock risks.
+ Customer Service teams to enable sales order growth.
+ Buyers to build upon best-practices.
* Build and maintain vendor relationships to not only support PO fulfillment, but also negotiate volume discounts and price breaks wherever possible.
* Manage Fusion system issues that impact Purchasing and Receiving.
* Maintain BFC dating system to minimize close dated issues and Expired product impact.

* 5+ years buying experience with a focus on Specialty Food Products for a multi-unit Distribution Organization.
* Bachelor’s degree from accredited four-year college or university preferred.
* Previous food service distribution and/or food importing experience strongly preferred.

description:
**Senior Buyer**

*Cartridge Actuated Devices, Inc. (CAD Energetics) | Fairfield, NJ*

**ABOUT CAD ENERGETICS**

Since 1963, Cartridge Actuated Devices, Inc. has designed, tested, and manufactured custom energetic and pyrotechnic devices. Our products serve mission-critical, man-rated applications in the military, aerospace, fire suppression, and oil and gas markets, where every device must perform "first time, every time."

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Buyer is responsible for procurement of the materials, components, and outsourced services that support CAD's energetic device production. The role manages commodity purchasing, supplier performance, and material replenishment, and serves as the link between Purchasing, suppliers, and internal stakeholders in Engineering, Quality, Production, and Sales. Because CAD products are used in critical applications, the Buyer ensures every purchased item meets the technical, quality, and regulatory requirements of our AS9100D quality management system.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Purchasing and Order Management**

* Generates purchase orders and manages blanket order releases, ensuring all engineering, quality, and contractual requirements are clearly defined and flowed down to suppliers.
* Prioritizes and expedites open and late orders; maintains the expediting list and communicates schedule risks to Production and management.
* Obtains and evaluates supplier quotes in support of customer bids, reviewing bid responses with the supervisor before finalizing purchases as needed.
* Sources and purchases specialized materials and components, including machined metal parts, hermetically sealed and glass-to-metal sealed components, energetic and chemical raw materials, and packaging compliant with hazardous materials shipping requirements.

**Supplier Quality and Performance**

* Assists with quality performance evaluations for all key suppliers, maintaining accurate records to support the Approved Supplier List.
* Ensure suppliers meet CAD quality requirements, including required certifications of conformance, material and test certifications, lot traceability, first article inspection, and counterfeit parts prevention.

* 401(k) plan
* Generous paid time off — including vacation, holidays, parental leave, and bereavement
* 100% employer-paid Health, Dental, and Vision insurance for employees and their dependents
* Employee Assistance Program
* Life Insurance

* Critical Illness and Accident insurance
* Annual Evaluations with the opportunity for a pay increase based on performance

We invest in our people because they are the foundation of our success.

Safety is a core value at Mesa. Positions identified as safety-sensitive require initial drug screening as a condition of employment, and employees in those roles may be subject to random testing in accordance with company policy.

Join Mesa Power Solutions and help us build the future of reliable power.

**Job Summary**
The Buyer II manages procurement activities of materials for natural-gas engine and generator production and service with greater autonomy, including negotiating supplier terms, proactively reducing cost and lead-time risks and resolving issues. This role balances tactical execution with analytical decision-making to support operational efficiency.

**Essential Duties**

* Manage end-to-end purchasing for assigned commodities or suppliers.
* Analyze MRP signals and adjust purchasing strategies accordingly.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, and terms (delivery/payment) within defined limits.
* Proactively mitigate supply risks and resolve delivery or quality issues.
* Develop and maintain supplier relationships, monitor performance and support corrective actions.
* Collaborate with Planning, Operations, and Engineering on part changes, cost/lead-time impacts, and supplier qualifications.
* Support cost savings and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and communicate supply risks.
* All other duties assigned.

**Education**
Required

* 4 Year / Bachelors Degree in Supply Chain, Business or related field from an accredited university.

**Experience**
Required

* 5 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain or technical field in an industrial / manufacturing environment.
* 3 years of experience managing suppliers and purchase orders independently.
* 3 years of exposure to MRP/ERP systems in a lean manufacturing or operations environment

Preferred

* 7 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain or technical field in an industrial / manufacturing environment.
* Experience with cost analysis or basic negotiations.
* Honorably discharged service veterans are preferred.

**Certifications, Licenses & Registrations**
Preferred

* APICS (CPIM/CSCP) or ISM (CPSM)

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities**

* Working knowledge of procurement, supply chain, and inventory management.
* Understanding of supplier performance metrics and cost drivers.
* Familiarity with contract terms and basic negotiation principles.
* Strong negotiation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective negotiation and supplier management skills.
* Proficiency in ERP systems and data analysis tools such as MS Excel.
* Ability to manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.
* Ability to make sound, data driven purchasing decisions.
* Ability to influence suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* Exposure to MRP/ERP systems in a lean manufacturing or operations environment.
* Must be able to fluently speak, write, and read in English.

**Culture Expectations**

* Action-oriented: Self-motivated, problem solver, takes initiative when issues arise, acting quickly and responding accordingly.
* Disciplined: Focused, consistently following through with dedication to achieve high standards even when no one is watching.
* Accountable: Takes ownership and accountability for your actions, good and bad.

Operations Group, Operations Group > Sourcing

**General Summary:**

Qualcomm Technologies Inc is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **Sourcing Specialist** to support procurement and sourcing activities for electronic components, materials, and services required for engineering development and production programs. The successful candidate will be responsible for supplier management, purchase order execution, cost optimization, delivery performance, and cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Planning, Manufacturing, and Supplier Quality teams.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience sourcing **RF components** and supporting wireless, telecommunications, networking, or semiconductor-related products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage sourcing and purchasing activities for assigned commodities and suppliers.
* Create, manage, and expedite purchase orders to ensure material availability and on-time delivery.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and production requirements through proactive supplier engagement.
* Analyze demand requirements and develop procurement strategies to support business objectives.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, and commercial terms with suppliers.
* Resolve supply, delivery, quality, and invoicing issues in a timely manner.
* Identify and mitigate material shortages, supply risks, and capacity constraints.
* Prepare spend analysis, supplier performance metrics, lead-time reporting, and other procurement-related analyses.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, and Finance teams.

**Core Competencies**

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across global time zones and manage communications with suppliers and internal stakeholders in Asia, India, and other international regions.
* Flexibility to accommodate critical business discussions, supplier escalations, and project meetings outside of standard local business hours as required, typically 2 times per week.

* Effective management of priorities and responsiveness in a global, fast-paced environment. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities and shifting business needs.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage a high volume of emails, supplier communications, and procurement transactions while maintaining responsiveness and accuracy.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, pivot tables, lookups, and trend analysis.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets and make data-driven decisions with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Supplier Relationship Management and Strategic Sourcing.
* Purchase Order Management.
* Cost Management and Cost Reduction.
* Negotiation and Influencing Skills.
* Inventory and Supply Continuity Management. Risk Identification and Mitigation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration with Customer Service Orientation to internal stakeholders

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree.

OR

Associate's degree and 2+ years of Sourcing or related work experience.

OR

High School Diploma or equivalent and 4+ years of Sourcing or related work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
* 3-7 years of procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain experience.
* Experience working with suppliers in a manufacturing, electronics, or technology environment.
* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Experience utilizing ERP/MRP systems such as Oracle, SAP, or similar platforms.
* Experience sourcing RF, wireless, networking, telecommunications, or semiconductor components.
* Knowledge of electronics manufacturing and global supply chains.
* Experience supporting engineering development programs and NPI activities.
* APICS, CPSM, or other supply chain certifications are a plus.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Strong Excel and data analysis skills, including pivot tables, lookups, reporting, and spend analysis.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Commodity Experience**

**RF / Wireless Components to include:**

Power Amplifiers (PA), Low Noise Amplifiers (LNA), RF Front-End Modules (FEM), RF Filters and Duplexers, Antennas, RF Connectors and Cable Assemblies, Oscillators and Timing Devices, and Wireless Communication Modules.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized sourcing professional who can effectively manage multiple suppliers, priorities, purchase orders, and communications simultaneously. They possess strong data analysis and Excel capabilities, communicate effectively with internal stake

Description:

**Signia Aerospace** is built on decades of proven performance and partnership in the aircraft systems industry. The proven brands that operate under the Signia Aerospace ecosystem lead the field in thermal management and mission-specific equipment. They are the brands of choice for pilots, maintenance directors, ground crews, and supply chain professionals worldwide, in commercial, private, and military applications. Our depth of expertise and unique pool of resources allows us to act as an integrated, nimble partner in the design, manufacture, delivery, and service of highly specialized aircraft systems and components.

**Precise Flight** is a leading designer and manufacturer of aviation safety and performance products for commercial, business, and general aviation aircraft worldwide. For more than 40 years, the company has developed innovative solutions including aircraft lighting systems, oxygen systems, and other aerospace components that help make flying safer and more efficient. Headquartered in Bend, Oregon, Precise Flight serves aircraft manufacturers, airlines, fleet operators, and aircraft owners around the globe.

**Our Culture**

We are a team that prides ourselves on a culture that supports shared values of empowerment, accountability, drive, integrity, and respect. Our team shares a deep commitment to safety and collaboration. We offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, life insurance, 401(K) plans with employer match, company provided Growth Participation Units (GPU) and so much more.

Our GPU benefit is unique to the industry and encourages all employees to think like owners and receive future financial reward for contributions to business growth. Join our team to be part of a culture that encourages growth and development and celebrates our success.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Executes procurement strategies and sourcing activities for assigned commodities, suppliers, or operational categories. Manages supplier selection, contract negotiations, procurement compliance, and supplier performance activities while supporting operational continuity, cost management, and supply chain efficiency. Collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure timely procurement execution and operational support.

All roles at Signia are expected to support the company’s operating model (SOAR) and contribute to the organization’s business value drivers, Profitable New Business, Productivity, Precision M&A, and Value-Based Pricing, through operational excellence, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer focus.

**Key Deliverables of the Position**

1) Effective execution of procurement strategies and sourcing activities

2) Successful supplier selection, contract negotiation, and procurement coordination

3) Reliable supplier delivery, quality, and performance management

4) Compliance with procurement policies, contracts, and regulatory requirements

5) Improved procurement efficiency, supplier responsiveness, and cost management

6) Accurate procurement reporting and supplier performance tracking

7) Strong supplier and cross-functional stakeholder relationships

Requirements:

**Education and Experience**

* Solid working knowledge of procurement and supply chain practices
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or related discipline preferred
* Typically requires 2–4 years of procurement, sourcing, or supply chain experience
* Works under general supervision and may mentor junior staff

**Technical Competencies**

1) Procurement strategy execution

2) Supplier selection and contract negotiation

3) RFQ/RFP management and sourcing processes

4) Supplier relationship and performance management

5) Procurement compliance and policy adherence

6) Cost analysis and operational support

7) Cross-functional collaboration and communication

8) Process improvement and problem-solving

9) Proficient Computer Skills – Microsoft Office and procurement systems

10) Excellent Communication Skills – both verbal and written

**Behavioral Competencies – Demonstrates behaviors consistent with our values**

**1)** **Thinks and acts like an owner**

o Uses company resources wisely & cost-effectively

o Shows pride in the organization and a commitment to its long-term success

o Takes full responsibility for their actions

o Holds self to high standards of performance and integrity

**2)** **Demonstrates high integrity**

o Consistently acts with honestly, transparency and high ethics

o Makes decisions based on what is morally right

o Owns their actions and holds self-accountable

**3)** **Puts team above self; in it together**

o Prioritizes team and company over personal gain

o Collaborates with team members within the department and across all functions

Contributes to a positive, inclusive work environment

**4)** **Innovates and improves**

o Actively support

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a **Senior Specialist, Procuremen**t to join our procurement team at our **Jupiter, FL** facility. Will also consider candidates to work **Remotely**.

**Essential Functions:**

* Procure critical path, components and services, in support of numerous organizational and manufacturing needs. * Active participation in company and departmental and enterprise improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 6 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 10 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of professional experience in purchasing within an MRP (ERP) driven manufacturing environment.
* Proven professional history and experience involving procurement negotiations.
* Experience in government / FAR buying environment is preferred but not necessary.
* Contract experience, including knowledge of terms and conditions, and other procurement agreement related experience.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
* Understanding and working knowledge of engineering documentation, product configuration

9/80

**About Veeco**
You probably don’t realize it, but what we do at Veeco touches the lives of every person, every day. It’s a bold statement, but it’s true. From the smartphones in our pockets that access the world’s collective knowledge, to the cloud-based services where all that information lives, to high-speed wireless communication and computing power needed to drive artificial intelligence, augmented and virtual reality, gaming and so much more, our technology is all around us.

We design, develop, manufacture, and service highly complex, cutting-edge machines used by our customers to create the essential devices that drive the digital age, connect the world, and improve the human experience. Along with the world’s leading technology companies, many of which are household names, we help solve their most difficult material science challenges, enabling technologies for a more connected, sustainable, and convenient world.

We’re looking for material difference-makers to join our growing team. Interested? Learn more at www.veeco.com/careers.

**OVERVIEW**

Veeco is seeking a strategic Category Manager to transform how we source the technologies, components, and manufacturing capabilities behind our advanced equipment. Depending on the candidate’s expertise and business needs, this high-impact role may support either OEM commercial off-the-shelf products or build-to-print custom manufacturing suppliers. We are looking for a candidate with deep strength in either supplier category who can shape global sourcing strategies, strengthen supply resilience, and deliver measurable business value.

The Category Manager will convert business and technical requirements into actionable category roadmaps, resilient supplier strategies, and commercial agreements that deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, capacity, innovation, and supply continuity. This role serves as a strategic partner to Engineering, Operations, Quality, Planning, Finance, and Supply Chain leadership, using market intelligence and sound judgment to influence decisions and strengthen Veeco's global supply network.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Category Strategy and Market Intelligence**

* Own and drive global category strategies, multi-year roadmaps, sourcing plans, and supplier segmentation for assigned direct-material or equipment categories, with accountability for business results.
* Analyze global markets, technologies, cost drivers, capacity, lead times, geopolitical exposure, and supplier trends to guide sourcing decisions.
* Build category plans that align product roadmaps and production requirements with cost objectives and long-term supply resilience.

**Supplier Model and Supply Base Management**

* Lead supplier strategies for an assigned category aligned with the candidate’s expertise and business needs, supporting either OEM commercial off-the-shelf products or build-to-print custom manufacturing.
* **OEM commercial off-the-shelf:** Manage OEM and authorized-channel relationships; evaluate technology and product roadmaps, pricing, availability, lead times, allocation, warranty, service, and total cost of ownership; and lead lifecycle, end-of-life, obsolescence, and supply-continuity planning.
* **Build-to-print custom manufacturing:** Translate drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and quality requirements into sourcing and supplier-execution plans; assess manufacturability, process capability, tooling, capacity, cost drivers, and production readiness; and coordinate qualification, first-article approval, revision control, and engineering changes.
* Develop, qualify, rationalize, and strengthen the applicable global supplier network through performance data, business reviews, corrective actions, improvement plans, and supplier development.

**Strategic Sourcing and Commercial Leadership**

* Lead RFIs, RFQs, competitive bids, supplier selections, and sourcing transitions from requirements definition through implementation.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, capacity commitments, payment terms, intellectual property protections, warranties, service levels, and other complex commercial terms.
* Apply should-cost, cost-modeling, market, and financial analysis to deliver savings, cost avoidance, and value-improvement opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Execution and Supplier Performance**

* Partner with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Planning, and Finance to optimize technical requirements, manufacturability, cost, quality, delivery, and risk.
* Establish clear supplier expectations and drive measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, and capacity, including corrective action and executive escalation when required.
* Coordinate sourcing decisions, supplier readiness, and continuity plans for production changes, engineering revisions, demand shifts, and product lifecycle events.

**Risk Management and Executive Communication**

* Anticipate and mitigate

Position Description

Responsible for managing all affairs between company and suppliers/subcontractors for various types of subcontracts/Purchase Orders including both fixed price and cost reimbursement.

About the role We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters. we build the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

We deliver the power to win. Every day, our global team looks beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges. Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Responsibilities Include: j

* Responsible for managing all affairs relative to the position of Procurement Buyer. - Analysis of Oracle system material needs. - Solicitation and preparation of Request for Quotes (RFQ's), Requests for Proposals (RFP's), and Request for Information (RFI's). j
* Cost analysis of proposals. - Price analysis of quotes. - Proposal fact finding. - Negotiate proposals and offers to meet program and cost targets. - Purchase Order preparation, placement and continued administration/monitoring to assure subcontractor compliance. j
* Administer subcontracts/purchase orders, control costs and assure on-time delivery to support program requirements. - Buying which includes analysis of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) needs. - Serve as the focal point between the suppliers and functional departments/program offices - Manage Quality, Design, Payment issues with subcontractors.
* Coordinate "Source Selection" process. - Ensure compliance with applicable procurement laws and regulations. - Administration of purchase orders via communication & onsite program reviews. - Review and access all planning to assure subcontracts/purchase orders are placed within Vendor lead-time. - Other duties as assigned

Position Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in a business area of study. Supply Chain Management preferred. - Ability to use Oracle system & associated computer systems. - Experience in cost and price analysis and write-ups. - Ability to negotiate. - Occasional domestic travel. - Possible International travel. - Strong communication (oral & written) and problem-solving skills. - Strong problem solving and program management skills. - Excellent business acumen. - Work in a team environment to meet team objectives and performance metrics. - Perform under pressure to meet deadlines, provide timely updates, and communicate status with all parties involved. - Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel & the Internet business applications are desired but are not mandated. - Strong understanding of procurement processes, systems and MRP. - Ability to multi-task and proper management of workday and buying deck.

Pay: $48.00 - $50.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

**Who We Are:**

For over 35 years, ISC has provided safe, high quality electrical, instrumentation and controls solutions to global leading industrial manufacturers. With offices in Baton Rouge, Beaumont, Houston, and Corpus Christi, Texas, as well as job sites around the country, ISC has grown our team as high as 3,000+ associates and offers full-service engineering, construction, and maintenance solutions throughout the United States.

**The Position:**

Supports the regional logistics and procurement daily activities of sourcing suppliers and purchasing products, equipment, and services to support work in the Columbus Regional Office.

This role will spend a significant amount of time supporting material management, warehouse operations, equipment coordination, and logistics functions in addition to procurement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for strategic resourcing, negotiating and long-term supplier relationships
* Coordinate material flow from suppliers to warehouse locations and final jobsites
* Monitor and expedite critical-path materials, long-lead equipment, and procurement risks
* Direct continuous improvement of purchasing processes in line with changing organizational needs and market conditions
* Evaluate suppliers based upon price, quality, and customer service leveraging purchases to maximize price discount
* Oversee the operations and daily activities of the purchasing department
* Assist with planning and execution of material staging, laydown areas, and site logistics
* Maintain procurement logs, material status reports, inventory records, and equipment tracking procurement, rentals, repairs, calibrations, and asset tracking databases
* Maintain procurement logs, material status reports, inventory records, and equipment tracking databases
* Support warehouse operations through inventory tracking, material transfers, jobsite releases, and receiving coordination
* Coordinate with project management, superintendents, warehouse personnel, vendors, and accounting teams to support uninterrupted field operations
* Assist project estimators with material quotes for bids
* Support project closeout activities including surplus material disposition, warranty tracking, equipment reconciliation, and vendor account resolution

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management or related field preferred
* Purchasing professional certifications a plus
* 5+ years of experience in a purchasing environment
* Experience working in a purchasing group required
* Industrial construction material procurement experience required
* Procurement of electrical construction materials a plus
* Onsite industrial and/or data center experience a plus
* Experience with an ERP system required - Vista experience a plus
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Products – Intermediate level required

### **Competencies:**

* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to maintain positive business relationships with suppliers and internal customers
* Strong analytical skills
* Motivated to recognize and resolve problems independently
* Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex documents
* Capacity to manage multiple priorities
* Willingness to work as part of a team

**Other Information:**

* Excellent wages and complete benefits package.
* We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
* ISC evaluates and hires applicants for employment based exclusively upon the applicant’s merit. No applicant will ever be required to pay money (or any other form of compensation) to an ISC employee in order to be hired by or considered for employment with the Company.
* This announcement is not intended to be a complete listing of all similar, miscellaneous, or incidental, duties, which may be required from day-to-day. ISC utilizes the multi-skill concept and expects all associates to perform other job requirements.

**Accessibility: If you need an accommodation as part of the employment process please contact Human Resources at**
**Phone: 225.756.7501**
**Email: hr@iscgrp.com**

**Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled and veterans.**

**If you want to view the Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal poster, click** **HERE**
**If you want to view the Pay Transparency Policy Statement, please click the link:** **Englis****h**

description:
The Enviva team is driven by our shared vision for a renewable energy future. We are a fast-growing, purpose-driven, global energy company specializing in delivering sustainable wood bioenergy solutions. We are the world's largest producer of sustainable wood pellets, which provide a low-carbon alternative to fossil fuels.

The Procurement Specialist has an important role in the Procurement Organization with the responsibility for the sourcing of equipment, goods, and services while reducing cost and ensuring on time delivery to meet organizations goals and objectives. This person will be responsible for managing and communicating the requirements of the organization to the supply base. This position will also facilitate the operations and implement procedures for effective stockroom management.

**Responsibilities**

* Evaluate approved requisitions for accuracy and potential cost savings.

* Execute approved purchase orders and distribute to approved vendors.

* Maintain vendor database utilizing current vendors and only adding vendors with added value to the organization.

* Manage relationships with key suppliers to maintain quality of goods, timely delivery and compliance with the organizations terms and conditions.

* Focus on consolidating vendors by developing synergies with other sites within the organization to achieve optimum cost savings.

* Support and implement Procurement leadership cost saving initiatives.

* Measure and hold suppliers accountable for performance as measured in supplier scorecards.

* Manage on-site vendors to ensure all procedures are followed.

* Coordinate with accounting to ensure pricing/invoicing accuracy.

* Assists receiving with delivery discrepancies.

* Support continuous improvement throughout the organization.

* Establish and implement procedures to ensure organization and effectiveness of the stockroom.

* Evaluate and determine proper inventory levels for the stockroom.

* Effectively communicate potential supply disruptions throughout the organization.

* Promote safety initiatives and enforce the organization's safety policies.

* Execute Enviva's OEMS System, Gembas, Coaching, Visual Administration, 5's, Material Strategy, Root Cause Analysis, Material and information flow, 7 wastes, VA and NVA activities, Continuous Improvement, TPM, Communication.

**Qualifications**

* Professional career on engineering, business or related - Desirable

* Strong Background on Commercial Negotiations.

* Stockroom management experience required.

* Professional Level of experience in the manufacturing industry is required.

* Basic knowledge on MRP.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in Purchasing/Materials Management areas.

**Physical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based with periodic visits to manufacturing facilities and warehouses.
* Ability to travel occasionally to supplier locations and company facilities.
* Ability to safely enter industrial environments while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).

This position is not eligible for visa support.

**EEO Statement**

Enviva is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity (EEO) in any term, condition or privilege of employment. Enviva does not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, ancestry, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniform service member, genetic information or any other status protected by law. Enviva complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which we operate.
