* Conducts pre-bid specification review conferences with bidders and City officials to resolve any conflicts or misunderstandings regarding bids; supervises and participates in the development of bid specifications; analyzes bids for compliance and makes recommendations on major purchases.
* Establishes and maintains contact and negotiations with vendors; remains informed of new products; develops new sources of supply and evaluates vendor performance.
* Establishes and maintains cooperative working relationships with those contacted in the course of work.
* Effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, with a variety of audiences.
* Maintains prompt and regular attendance.
* Sound judgement and attention to detail.
* Perform any other tasks or functions deemed necessary to the daily operations of the employer or as the situation requires.
* This position is always evolving. Therefore, employer reserves the right to modify this job description as necessary.

* Federal, state, county, and city regulations regarding purchasing methods and practices.
* Governmental purchasing practices, principles, and terminology related to a wide variety of products and services.

* Principles and procedures of financial record keeping and reporting.
* General laws and regulations applicable to the formal bidding process.
* Operational characteristics, services and activities of a comprehensive municipal purchasing program.
* Budgeting methodologies.
* Familiarity with purchasing standards, practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Relevant tools, software, and/or technology used within the role.
* Understanding of organizational policies, procedures, and best practices.
* Principles and practices of excellent customer service.

**Job Title:** Supply Chain Procurement Manager

**Job Location:** Redmond, WA

**Job Schedule:** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Supply Chain Leader to build, optimize, and scale a high-performing supply chain organization across a growing multi-site aerospace manufacturing enterprise. This role will lead end-to-end supply chain operations including sourcing, procurement, planning and supplier development.

The ideal candidate brings deep aerospace or highly regulated manufacturing experience and has successfully stood up or transformed a modern, efficient supply chain organization in a complex operational environment. This leader will drive operational excellence, supplier performance, cost competitiveness, and scalable processes that support rapid growth, delivery performance, and customer satisfaction.

This position requires a hands-on leader who can balance strategic vision with tactical execution across multiple facilities and product lines.

The successful candidate will be a strategic yet hands-on leader with a strong operational mindset, capable of driving change in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This individual should bring a track record of building efficient organizations, improving execution, and developing high-performing teams.

This is an opportunity to play a critical leadership role in shaping the future operations and scalability of a growing aerospace organization.

**Essential Functions:**

* Strategic Leadership
+ Develop and execute an enterprise-wide supply chain strategy aligned with company growth objectives, customer commitments, and operational priorities.
+ Build and lead a multi-site supply chain organization that is standardized, scalable, and performance-oriented.
+ Assess current-state processes, organizational structure, systems, and capabilities; design and implement a future-state operating model that improves efficiency, visibility, and accountability.
+ Lead procurement, strategic sourcing, planning, and supplier development across multiple sites
+ Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, partnering closely with Operations, Program Management, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and Business Development.
* Organizational Design and Transformation
+ Lead the stand-up, redesign, or transformation of the supply chain organization, including roles, responsibilities, governance, and process ownership.
+ Establish clear functional alignment across sourcing, procurement, planning, master scheduling, inventory control, logistics, and supplier management.
+ Drive standard work, common metrics, and integrated planning processes across all sites.
+ Build organizational capability through talent assessment, coaching, succession planning, and targeted hiring.
* Procurement and Supplier Management
+ Lead strategic sourcing and procurement activities to ensure cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and strong supplier performance.
+ Develop supplier segmentation, risk management, and performance management processes to improve quality, delivery, responsiveness, and resilience.
+ Negotiate key supplier agreements and partnerships, including long-term agreements where appropriate.
+ Partner with Quality and Engineering to strengthen supplier qualification, development, and corrective action processes.
* Planning, Inventory, and Operations Support
+ Improve material availability and on-time delivery while optimizing inventory, working capital, and lead times.
+ Drive cross-functional execution to resolve shortages, constraints, and capacity issues.
* Systems, Process, and Performance Improvement
+ Champion the use of ERP/MRP systems, analytics, and reporting tools to improve planning accuracy, material visibility, and decision-making.
+ Implement KPIs and management operating rhythms focused on on-time delivery, supplier quality, lead time, inventory turns, material availability, and cost performance.
+ Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence methodologies.
+ Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace, regulatory, contractual, and customer requirements.

**Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated manufacturing
* Experience leading end-to-end supply chain functions, including sourcing, procurement, planning, inventory management, logistics, and supplier performance.
* Strong track record of driving measurable improvements in on-time delivery, inventory performance, cost, supplier reliability, and process efficiency.
* Proven success building, transforming, or scaling supply chain organizations
* Demonstrated capability leading supply chain operations across multiple manufacturing sites
* Strong background in strategic sourcing, planning, supplier mana

**Entry-Level Procurement Specialist**

**RCI Custom**

**Start Your Career in Supply Chain & Purchasing**

RCI Custom is looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Entry-Level Procurement Specialist** to join our growing team. If you’re someone who enjoys problem-solving, working with vendors, and keeping operations running smoothly, this is a great opportunity to build a long-term in purchasing and supply chain management.

You’ll work closely with our Shop Operations team to ensure materials and components are ordered, tracked, and delivered on time to support production.

**What You’ll Do**

* Assist with purchasing raw materials, electronic components, and outside services
* Create and manage purchase orders using our ERP system
* Communicate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, and delivery updates
* Track open orders and help ensure on-time delivery of materials
* Review incoming materials and support documentation accuracy
* Kit parts for production work orders
* Help maintain organized purchasing and inventory records

**What You’ll Learn**

* Procurement and supply chain fundamentals
* Vendor communication and relationship management
* Inventory control and material planning
* ERP systems (JobBoss)
* ISO 9001:2015 quality standards
* Cost control and purchasing strategies

**What We’re Looking For**

* High school diploma or equivalent (associate’s degree is a plus)
* Basic skills in Microsoft Excel and Outlook
* Strong attention to detail and organization
* Good communication and problem-solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn

**Nice to Have (Not Required)**

* Exposure to manufacturing, electronics, or warehouse environments
* Basic understanding of inventory or purchasing processes

**Why Join RCI Custom?**

* Great entry point into a growing field with career advancement opportunities
* Hands-on training and mentorship
* Collaborative team environment
* Opportunity to learn valuable, transferable business skills
* Health benefits
* 401k
* Paid time off & holidays

**Apply Today**

If you’re ready to start your career in procurement and be part of a team that keeps operations moving, we’d love to hear from you.

Pay: $18.00 - $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary**

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer supports nursery operations by monitoring stock levels, sourcing plant material, and ordering replenishments for assigned departments. This role works closely with vendors, receiving staff, and internal teams to ensure plant material and related inventory are available to meet operational and sales needs while avoiding shortages, overstocks, or inactive inventory.

The Stocking Specialist / Buyer manages purchase orders, coordinates deliveries, resolves vendor issues, and maintains accurate vendor and inventory records. This role balances daily operational needs with efficient purchasing practices to support consistent product availability across the nursery.

**Essential Functions**

* Research and source plant material for special orders requested by the Sales Team.
* Maintain positive and effective relationships with plant vendors and suppliers.
* Maintain and update vendor information in company systems.
* Create and process purchase orders for plant material and related items.
* Verify receipt of purchased materials and work with vendors to resolve shipment discrepancies, shortages, or damages.
* Negotiate with vendors to obtain competitive pricing while maintaining quality standards.
* Ensure purchase documentation and approvals are completed so vendor payments can be processed in a timely manner.
* Serve as a liaison between internal departments and vendors to coordinate purchasing and delivery needs.
* Work with vendors to schedule or expedite deliveries and resolve delivery issues such as shortages, late deliveries, or missed shipments.
* Coordinate logistics to ensure plant material arrives at the appropriate nursery location in a timely manner.
* Monitor changes in plant availability, vendor pricing, and purchasing terms.
* Participate in pricing updates, inventory projects, and other operational initiatives as needed.
* Support administrative tasks related to purchasing, inventory, and vendor coordination.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Assist with inventory-related projects and operational initiatives as needed.
* Support cross-departmental coordination related to purchasing and stocking activities.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Experience & Other Requirements**

**Required**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience working in a nursery, horticulture, or related industry.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate multiple purchasing and inventory activities simultaneously.

**Preferred**

* Associate degree (AA) or higher.
* Experience creating purchase orders within inventory or ERP systems.
* Familiarity with plant sourcing and vendor coordination within nursery operations.

**Work Environment & Physical Requirements**

This is an in-office position located at the nursery site. Remote work is not available except for short-term situations approved in advance by upper management.

The role requires regular movement between office and nursery yard environments.

Physical requirements include:

* Remaining in a stationary position (sitting or standing) for extended periods.
* Frequent typing and use of computer systems including data entry and 10-key functions.
* Use of hands and fingers for typing, filing, and operating office equipment.
* Gross grasping and manual handling of documents or office materials.
* Occasional walking through outdoor nursery areas which may involve uneven ground surfaces and exposure to varying weather conditions.
* Lifting up to 20 lbs. approximately 20% of the time.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Reporting to the Director of Procurement, you will support Protein Procurement by leading research, implementing category strategies, resolving complex supply challenges, and building relationships with internal teams and external suppliers. You will perform detailed category analysis, forecasting, and reporting while collaborating across functions to identify process improvements and strategic opportunities.

**A Taste of Your Responsibilities**
------------------------------------

* Manage purchasing and negotiations for assigned protein categories based on market conditions and business requirements.
* Develop category strategies informed by supply and demand, market dynamics, and cost drivers.
* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.
* Support contract and position management using Excel, Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing software, RightAngle, Profitability and Performance Management, and other internal systems.
* Serve as the primary contact for contract management support across assigned areas.
* Identify and mitigate material supply risks in partnership with procurement category managers and cross-functional teams.
* Support Research and Development initiatives and manage inbound supply considerations for innovation projects.
* Implement enterprise procurement initiatives across assigned brands.
* Gather data and conduct risk-and-reward analyses for purchasing bids and specification change initiatives.
* Collaborate across functions to manage raw material inventories and minimize loss or obsolescence.
* Deliver accurate monthly forecasts and communicate changes in material costs and market drivers to stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier quality and service performance with internal customers.
* Champion corrective actions and quality improvement plans with facilities, Quality Assurance, Research and Development, and suppliers.

**Ingredients Required for Your Success**
-----------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience in Purchasing, Supply Chain, or Finance.
* Experience working in a matrixed environment with changing priorities.
* Project management and conflict management experience.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on efficiency.
* Experience using Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing software or a comparable enterprise resource planning system.
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and data relationships.
* Advanced PowerPoint presentation development skills.
* Experience working with Power Business Intelligence reporting.
* Experience supporting procurement digital initiatives.
* Familiarity with artificial intelligence tools and Copilot functionality.
* Minimal travel required.
* Availability to work in the office 3 days per week, Tuesday through Thursday.

Pay Range:$64,000-$95,000

* Health: Comprehensive healthcare plans, wellness incentive program, mental wellbeing support and fitness reimbursement
* Wealth: Great pay, bonus incentive opportunity, matching 401(k) and stock purchase plan
* Growth: Career development opportunities, employee resource groups, on-demand learning and tuition reimbursement
* Balance: Paid-time off, parental leave, flexible work-schedules (subject to your location and role) and volunteer opportunities

**Company Overview**

Specified Technologies Inc. (STI) is an industry leader in the development of firestopping systems, smoke and sound control products, and innovative construction solutions. For over 36 years, STI has partnered with contractors, engineers, and building owners to provide tested, trusted, and code‑compliant solutions worldwide.

Headquartered in Somerville, New Jersey, the company has grown to serve multiple markets and geographies and remains committed to innovation, safety, and performance in passive fire protection.

**Role Description**

We’re seeking an experienced **Procurement Specialist**. The ideal candidate will maximize ERP/MRP utilization (specifically within Acumatica or SAP), build strong vendor relationships, mitigate supply chain risks, streamline inventory and operational workflows, and establish a best-in-class supplier relationship management program.

This is a **hybrid** role based out of our Corporate Headquarters in **Somerville, New Jersey** with an expectation of **three days per week in the office.**

**Key areas of experience**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration (Manufacturing, NPI & Planning)
* Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
* Systems & Operational Integration
* Contract Negotiation & Supplier Management
* Supplier Performance Control
* Financial & Budgetary Oversight
* Leadership & Team Development
* Ability to meet or exceed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs & Metrics)
* Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required or assigned.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).

**Experience**

* 5-10+ years of progressive procurement/sourcing experience in manufacturing environments, specializing in Chemical procurement.

**Skills**

Primary Purpose

The Procurement Specialist supports the Agency’s procurement and inventory operations by maintaining accurate vendor

and inventory records, processing inventory submissions, assisting Staff with quotes and purchasing needs, monitoring

stock and pricing fluctuations, and ensuring timely, organized, and compliant procurement activities.

Education and Qualification Requirements

* Minimum: High School Diploma or Equivalency
* Valid Florida Driver's License
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Basic knowledge of general office equipment

Duties

* Provide customer service to walk‑in Staff members and respond to procurement‑related inquiries.
* Maintain vendor records, insurance certificates, catalogs, and supplier performance data.
* Source and evaluate vendors, obtain quotes, and support purchasing decisions.
* Enter and process requisitions, procurement forms, and inventory submissions.
* Monitor stock levels, pricing, and reorder points; research pricing and bulk purchase options.
* Review purchase orders, confirm vendor receipt, and support PO processing as needed.
* Manage issued property records and coordinate returns or transfers for Staff members.
* Update inventory‑related spreadsheets and run reports as requested.
* Maintain accurate files in agency systems and support annual inventory activities.
* Handle multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and apply procurement best practices while adhering to Agency

policies and confidentiality requirements.

* Other duties as assigned.

Job Controls and Complexities

* Report directly to Supervisor.
* Adhere to laws/agency policy/rules/ regulations/SOP/ procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality/security of files and information obtained in the course of employment.
* Process/compile/disseminate record/public record information as directed by approving authority in accordance

with lawful requirements.

* Maintain continuity and operational efficiency by accurate and timely dissemination of information to Staff and

co-workers.

* Adhere to leave, overtime and attendance policies/procedures (i.e. arrive promptly, regular attendance at work,

notification to supervisor regarding absence from work due to illness or untimely incidents, etc.)

* Demonstrates strong teamwork, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Takes initiative, troubleshoot issues, and maintain momentum on assignments.
* Works independently with sound judgment while following verbal and written instructions.
* Prepares clear, accurate, and timely documentation.
* Applies logical, collaborative problem‑solving techniques to ensure efficient use of resources.
* Maintains professionalism, tact, and diplomacy in difficult situations when working with colleagues, other

agencies, vendors, and the public.

Contacts

* SJSO Employees
* Other government employees
* General Public
* Vendors and Suppliers

Grade Classification

* Entry to intermediate level work.
* Performs independently under general supervision.
* Work requires application of general knowledge of business practices in various situations.
* Deals with problems or situations that remain stable.

Physical Environment

* Work is primarily in an office environment under normal amount of stress.
* Normal business hours apply; however, hours are subject to vary and overtime may be necessary including nights,

weekends, and holidays.

description:
The Specialist, Procurement is responsible for executing procurement activities in support of defense and aerospace programs, including the acquisition of raw materials, components, assemblies, equipment, and services necessary to meet program, production, and customer requirements. This role applies professional procurement knowledge to support supplier selection, pricing analysis, purchase order administration, and supplier performance management while ensuring alignment with quality, cost, delivery, and compliance objectives. The position works under general supervision and contributes to operational and program success through effective sourcing, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team supporting complex programs in a highly regulated environment.

**Essential Functions:**

* Plans and executes procurement activities for raw materials, components, equipment, and services in support of defense and aerospace program requirements.
* Solicits, reviews, and analyzes supplier quotations, proposals, and bids to support sourcing decisions and cost objectives.
* Negotiates pricing, terms and conditions, and delivery commitments in accordance with company policies and program requirements.
* Issues and administers purchase orders through completion, including management of acknowledgements, deliveries, invoice discrepancies, and order closeout.
* Evaluates supplier capability, performance, and risk related to quality, cost, schedule, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinates with internal stakeholders including engineering, manufacturing, quality, program management, and finance to ensure procurement actions support technical and contractual requirements.
* Resolves supplier-related issues involving shortages, damages, returns, over-shipments, cancellations, and engineering or configuration changes.
* Maintains accurate procurement records and supports audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and reporting requirements.
* Reviews market conditions, supplier trends, and pricing data to recommend sourcing strategies and process improvements.
* Ensures procurement activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual requirements, anti-corruption standards, and ethical business practices.
* May provide guidance, coaching, or day-to-day support to less experienced employees within the job area
* Travel up to 20% may be required.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant procurement experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related procurement experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related procurement experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience supporting defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments.
* Knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) requirements.
* Experience procuring electronic components, mechanical parts, complex assemblies, or specialized services.
* Familiarity with supplier performance management, cost analysis, and schedule risk mitigation.
* Experience supporting engineering change activity, configuration changes, and material returns.
* Working knowledge of export compliance considerations, including International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
* Experience using material requirements planning or enterprise resource planning tools in a production or program environment.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Washington, and the Greater D.C. area, Denver, or NYC areas is $79,000.00 - $147,000.00. The salary range for this role in Colorado state, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, Minnesota, New York state, Cleveland Ohio, Vermont and Virginia is $69,500.00 - $128,500.00 This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. The specific programs and options available to an employee may vary depending on date of hire, schedule type, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

**Job Schedule:** 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off

**Job Description:**

Rocketdyne is currently seeking a Procurement Specialist to contribute to the success and growth of our Space business located in Mason, OH, supporting the procurement and management of machined and electronics components. The Procurement Specialist determines how to achieve objectives by applying a deep understanding of procurement principles, concepts, and practices in a DoD environment. This position requires a minimum of 6 years’ experience in defense procurement and manufacturing.

**Essential Functions:**

* Procure components and subassemblies to support various programs, including commodities such as electronic, mechanical, optical components or assemblies, capital equipment, and electronic/optical systems. The primary focus of this role will be on electronics.
* Manage Purchase Orders (POs) and other agreements for direct and indirect procurements; Includes preparation of Requests for Quotes (RFQs) and Requests for Proposals (RFPs), proposal evaluation and analysis, and issuance and maintenance of POs.
* Select and recommend suppliers, negotiate pricing, delivery, quality, terms and conditions, and execute non-disclosure agreements and service agreements.
* Contribute to material cost reduction strategy. Create and issue various types of POs, including Firm-Fixed Price and Time & Material.
* Lead source selection teams; conduct formal cost/price analysis to determine price fair and reasonableness. Negotiate the lowest possible total cost for the product (balance price with optimum quality and schedule needs).
* Identify opportunities to mitigate supply chain risk.
* Administer post-award of issued POs.
* Create purchase orders files in compliance with all command media and necessary process disciplines for audits.
* Support Integrated Product Teams (IPT) through supply chain representative or as an active team member.
* Monitor and provide feedback to IPT on critical supplier performance to ensure timely delivery to manufacturing schedules; Inter and Intra departmental coordination is essential.
* Active participation in company and department initiatives such as strategic sourcing and various L3Harris improvement efforts.
* Provide training and mentorship to peers to further Inter departmental growth.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience or in lieu of a degree a minimum of 6 years of supply chain experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated manufacturing
* Strong background in strategic sourcing, planning, supplier management, and inventory optimization
* Knowledge of aerospace quality and regulatory environments including AS9100, FAA, DoD, or ITAR requirements preferred

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience using advanced Excel skills including use of pivot tables, lookup tables, etc.
* Knowledge within Deltek, Costpoint, and SAP.
* Knowledge in the procurement processes of military grade products.
* Demonstrated experience working within proposal teams, generating material estimates for bids and proposals, and providing substantiating evidence as needed is a plus.
* Willingness to learn DoD 5000.02 framework and Earned Value Management principles.
* Proven ability to direct and manage multiple projects with effective prioritization and resource allocation.
* Strong team player with excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills.
* Superior verbal and written communication abilities, along with strong organizational, negotiation, and management skills.
* Advanced computer skills, including proficiency to quicky learn ERP systems and MS Office applications, particularly Excel.
* Capability in reading and interpreting specifications, statements of work, and technical drawings.
* Extensive knowledge of FARS, DFARS, and ITAR regulations as they pertain to purchasing requirements.
* Extensive understanding of company policies and processes.
* Extensive understanding of small business government requirements.
* A strong commitment to learn continuous improvement methodologies, including Lean Six Sigma tools.

description:
Are you the detail-obsessed problem solver who catches the pricing error before it costs a dime and keeps every order on track from PO to warehouse? Do you believe a great bid starts with accurate takeoffs and clean data? ACS is looking for an organized, analytical Procurement Specialist to own material purchasing, bid estimating, and pricing accuracy for our Commercial division: protecting margin and keeping our projects moving.

Welcome to ACS: Commercial & Residential Flooring Specialists, where innovation meets a values-driven culture.

At ACS, we’re more than a flooring company. We’re a growing, collaborative community grounded in four core values: Say Yes, Own It, Do What You Say, and We Care. These principles shape how we work, solve problems, and support each other every day.

As the Procurement Specialist, you will own material ordering and tracking for ACS Commercial, working alongside the Project Coordinator to get material where it needs to be, when it needs to be there. You will build large and complex bid quotes, source product and vendor pricing for the sales team, audit cost and freight, and serve as the owner of our product library, turnkey pricing, catalog, and quote templates.

Your work will directly impact margin, quote accuracy, and on-time material delivery; turning vendor pricing and project plans into bids that win and orders that arrive right the first time.

**Your objectives may be similar to:**

* Owning material ordering and tracking for sold jobs, ensuring every PO is accurate and every order is confirmed at the warehouse.
* Building accurate, competitive bid quotes and sourcing product and vendor pricing for commercial, multifamily, and property management projects.
* Protecting margin through disciplined cost, invoice, and freight auditing.
* Owning the product library, turnkey pricing, catalog, and quote templates so the sales team can quote quickly and accurately.

**Essential Functions**

(Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)

**Ordering & Material Tracking**

* Place material orders for sold jobs and confirm PO accuracy against the quote.
* Track every open order until material is confirmed at the servicing warehouse, working alongside the Project Coordinator.
* Flag delays, backorders, shortages, and substitutions to sales and the Project Coordinator the same day.

**Bid Estimating & Product Sourcing**

* Build large and complex bid quotes for property management, multifamily, and commercial projects.
* Source products and obtain vendor pricing for the sales team’s bid work, including special-order and non-catalog items.
* Read plans and measures to produce accurate takeoffs, scope, and material quantities.
* Review quotes built by sales and field teams for accuracy and margin before they go out.

**Cost & Freight Audit**

* Audit vendor invoices, material cost, and freight against quotes and POs.
* Identify overcharges, billing errors, and margin leaks, and work with vendors to resolve them.
* Report monthly on cost, freight, and margin trends to the VP of Sales and National Accounts.

**Product Library, Pricing & Templates**

* Lead the initial cleanup of the product library to align with the turnkey catalog, and finalize turnkey pricing in partnership with Finance and the VP.
* Build quote templates that enable sales reps and Field Support Managers to quote quickly and accurately.
* Build and maintain property key guides outlining approved products, specs, and pricing by property for managed accounts.

The position exercises independent judgment on significant procurement matters, advises District leadership on procurement requirements and risks, and supports efficient, transparent, and compliant acquisition of goods and services.

**Job Type: Full Time, 12 Month Exempt**

**Salary:** $65,115.00 - 81,805.00. *Placement in the range will be based on a combination of education, industry related experience and certification.*

**Benefits****:** EVIT offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes: employer-paid Medical Insurance, Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution, basic life insurance, and Employee Assistance Program. Our benefits package also provides a comprehensive choice of voluntary benefits that include dental, vision, supplemental and dependent life insurance, short-term disability, prepaid legal, accident, and critical illness insurance. Please note, that it is mandatory to participate in the Arizona State Retirement System plan (ASRS), which includes the regular contribution rate of 11.87% for retirement and 0.11% for Long-Term Disability per pay period. EVIT matches the retirement contribution dollar for dollar.

**Education and Experience:**

+ Associate degree in business, accounting, finance, supply chain management, public administration, or related field, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
+ At least three years of progressively responsible purchasing or procurement experience, including competitive purchasing and contract-related work.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

+ Three or more years of public-sector procurement experience, preferably in an Arizona school district, CTED, community college, municipality, county, or state agency.
+ Experience independently administering formal IFB's and RFPs; knowledge of Arizona School District Procurement Rules, USFR, and Federal Uniform Guidance.
+ CPPB, CPPO, or NIGP-CPP certification; experience with iVisions or similar governmental financial software.

**Licensing / Certification and Other Requirements:**

+ Valid Arizona Department of Public Safety Identity Verified Prints (IVP) fingerprint clearance card.
+ Proof of immunization against or immunity to measles and rubella if born after January 1, 1957.

EVIT programs are tuition-free for high school students who live within the following school districts: Apache Junction, Cave Creek, Chandler, Fountain Hills, Gilbert, Higley, J.O. Combs, Mesa, Queen Creek, Scottsdale, and Tempe. EVIT offers adult programs that allow adults to improve their current skills or learn new skills. Adult programs have additional fees associated with them. For more information about EVIT, visit www.evit.edu.

**EVIT Mission Statement**
To change lives by loving our students and serving our communities with a career and college preparatory training experience that produces a qualified workforce, meeting the market-driven needs of business and industry.

**An Equal Opportunity Employer**
The East Valley Institute of Technology is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against any individual on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, gender, marital status, religion, veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, or socioeconomic status. In accordance with Arizona law and Governing Board Policy, the East Valley Institute of Technology maintains a smoke-free, tobacco-free work environment.

participate and lead cross functional teams as appropriate to bring continuous

USMCA & Trade Compliance Specialist (Freight Forwarding)

**Entry Level**

**Department:** Procurement / Trade Compliance

**Reports To:** Procurement Manager

**Level:** Entry Level

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Works across Procurement, Logistics/Supply Chain, and Finance/Accounting departments

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The USMCA & Freight Forwarding Specialist supports trade compliance and logistics coordination for imported and exported goods. This entry-level role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants to build expertise in international trade, customs compliance, and supply chain finance. The specialist will receive training and guidance while taking on real responsibility for SAP financial entries, carrier coordination, and export documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

***Financial & SAP Duties***

* Create and post ledger vouchers in SAP for customs entry payments (duties, taxes, broker fees)
* Reconcile entry payment records against carrier/broker invoices, with guidance from senior staff as needed
* Maintain accurate documentation for audit and compliance purposes

***Carrier & Logistics Coordination***

* Request and review quotes from carriers for freight and logistics services
* Assist in coordinating shipment scheduling and tracking for imported and exported goods
* Communicate with carriers, customs brokers, and internal teams to help resolve shipping issues

***Trade Documentation & Compliance***

* Prepare Commercial Invoices for exported goods
* Prepare and issue Certificates of Origin (USMCA) for qualifying exports
* Learn and apply USMCA rules of origin and customs documentation standards
* Support recordkeeping for import/export compliance

***Cross-Departmental Collaboration***

* Coordinate with Procurement on purchase orders and import-related needs
* Partner with Logistics/Operations on shipment timing and delivery requirements
* Work with Finance/Accounting on payment processing and cost allocation

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, International Business, Logistics, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 0–1 years of professional experience; internships or coursework in trade, logistics, or finance a plus
* Basic understanding of import/export concepts (training provided)
* Familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems preferred, not required
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Comfortable managing communication across multiple departments and external vendors
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook

**Preferred (Not Required)**
----------------------------

* Coursework or exposure to USMCA/NAFTA trade regulations
* Internship experience in freight forwarding, customs brokerage, or procurement

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Structured on-the-job training in trade compliance and logistics
* Mentorship from Procurement Manager and cross-functional teams
* Career growth path toward Trade Compliance Analyst or Logistics Coordinator roles

**About Carvana**

If you thrive on disrupting the status quo and want to join a company revolutionizing an industry, you'll love what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. We're reimagining the way people buy cars — and having a lot of fun doing it. Have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and every day we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories! We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not taking our foot off the gas now.

**About the team and position**

Creating an extraordinary customer experience is at the heart of Carvana. Our goal is to place the customer in control of the car buying experience and infuse honesty and transparency back into the car buying process. The **Senior Buyer, Procurement** is a key sourcing position that will handle a variety of tactical and strategic tasks, including request for quotation (RFQ) and purchase order (PO) entry/submission and order tracking. This role will support procurement activity across the business. Additional duties of this position include data collection and analysis, assembling and publishing reports and providing support to Category Managers, Specialists and to Management.

**What you'll be doing**

* Leading the IT Procurement process. This position interfaces directly with Carvana Technology Services leadership on all contract renewals, net-new contracts, and identifying areas for supplier improvement through Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).
* Negotiating favorable contract renewals and net-new contracts. You'll work closely with the Carvana Legal team in drafting and executing contracts.
* Collect, compile and analyze data and provide reports as needed, using MS SQL and Snowflake with a demonstrated ability with AI coding tools such as Claude or Codex.
* Ownership and accountability for the entire PO procurement process to include sending purchase orders, confirming order acknowledgement, expediting (as needed), and confirming Suppliers are paid.
* Communicate the status of current purchase orders with requesters and others as needed.
* Receive and execute ad-hoc requests that are external to the procurement system for any areas of the business the procurement platform has not yet been implemented.
* Maintain and adhere to procurement budgets, ensuring fiscal responsibility and cost efficiency.
* Follow up on invoice discrepancies as required.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What you should have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain, or relevant field and 5+ years experience OR
* 8+ years of experience in Procurement or Accounting.
* CPSM certification is a plus.
* Experience with Coupa or other leading Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and/or dedicated e-procurement platforms (preferred).
* Demonstrated accuracy, responsiveness, and follow-through; strong multitasking ability, close attention to detail, quantitative aptitude, and genuine curiosity about how things work.
* Ability to work collaboratively on a team as well as independently; actively engaged across the full procurement lifecycle and aligned with Carvana's core values.
* Ability to organize workload efficiently, meet tight deadlines, problem solve effectively, and perform duties of the job accurately and with input and follow-up from management.
* Proficient in the use of SQL, SnowFlake, MS Excel, and ERP systems.

**What we'll offer in return**

* Competitive full-time salary.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* 401K with company match.
* A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.
* A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.
* Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.
* A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.
* A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

**Other requirements**

In order to perform the essential functions of this role, candidates must meet the following baseline requirements:

* Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Carvana will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their role.

**Legal stuff**

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**Job Summary**

The Purchasing Coordinator at The Fischer Group supports the Supply Chain Team by coordinating purchasing information and processes that help ensure materials and labor reach Fischer Homes job sites accurately and on time. In this role, you will help maintain purchase orders, vendor and pricing records, and trade partner capacity information for the divisions you support. Your attention to detail and follow-through will help keep purchasing activities organized and give internal teams and trade partners the information they need.

*You Will Thrive in This Role If You…*

* Take a detail-focused approach to maintaining purchasing, vendor, pricing, and payment information.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with trade partners and internal partners across field management, estimating, accounting, and purchasing.
* Investigate questions using available information and help identify practical, solution-focused next steps.
* Stay organized while managing recurring reports, administrative work, and requests that vary by task and timing.
* Use sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality when handling work-related information.
* Work comfortably with office productivity applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint or Google equivalents.

*These skills will be used to:*

* Support Senior and Lead Purchasing Coordinators with assigned tasks and provide administrative support to the Supply Chain Team.
* Coordinate communication among trade partners, field managers, estimating, and accounting for one or more supported divisions.
* Create purchase orders as requested by the Purchasing Manager and maintain standard vendor lists for supported communities.
* Enter and maintain vendor pricing, create relevant bid items, and complete other ERP-related tasks.
* Help Purchasing Managers keep trade partner capacity information accurate in relevant systems.
* Research purchase order and payment information and distribute reports on weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annual schedules, as required.

*Required Qualifications:*

* High school diploma or equivalent.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Associate or bachelor's degree.
* Experience in the homebuilding industry.
* Experience in a role with purchasing- or procurement-related responsibilities.

*Physical demands and work environment:*

* Must be able to use sensory skills (i.e. verbal communication) to effectively communicate and interact with other Associates and customers.
* Must be able to perform repetitive motions and use fine motor skills (i.e. typing, writing) to operate office supplies (i.e. computer, calculator, copier).
* Must be able to lift and carry approximately 20-25lbs unassisted.
* Must be able to sit for long periods of time with low periods of reaching and standing.

**The Value of a career with Fischer Homes**

Fischer Homes is one of the largest and most reputable home builders in the Midwestern and Southeastern states. Founded in 1980, the company has grown to build over 40,000 homes and employs over 700 Associates. Fischer Homes' solid reputation has been built largely by the talent of our Associates as we have been recognized as the 32nd largest builder in the United States.

We value diversity within the Fischer Homes organization and see each Associate as a team member and valuable asset. We select highly competent individuals to join our team, provide them with the resources, training, and development possible to make significant contributions and drive their success while determining their career paths. The rewards for their efforts are:

* Professional Development Training programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Competitive Compensation
* 401(k) with Company matching contributions and profit-sharing
* Employee Life Insurance
* Personal time off
* Inclusive Leave

Fischer Homes holds the highest ethical standards of business. We are honest and straightforward and will stand by our word. Our actions demonstrate respect, courtesy, and above all, fairness.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Buyer is responsible for the timely, accurate, and cost-effective procurement of raw materials, tooling, manufacturing supplies, and assigned outside services required to support A1J Technologies’ precision manufacturing operations. As A1J advances from a traditional job-shop model toward a scalable Tier 1 supplier for commercial aerospace and defense customers, this position strengthens supplier reliability, material traceability, purchasing discipline, and delivery performance.

Reporting to the Supply Chain & Logistics Manager, the Senior Buyer executes sourcing and purchasing activities, negotiates with suppliers, expedites critical requirements, and works cross-functionally with Planning & Production Control, Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Quality, Logistics, and Finance. This is a senior individual-contributor role; purchasing strategy, staffing, and departmental leadership remain with the Supply Chain & Logistics Manager.

1. Procurement Execution & Material Availability

* Execute purchase requisitions and release accurate purchase orders for assigned raw materials, tooling, consumables, MRO items, and approved outside services within delegated authority.
* Review demand, lead times, specifications, inventory availability, and production priorities before placing orders.
* Proactively track open purchase orders, obtain supplier acknowledgments, and expedite shortages or delivery risks affecting production commitments.
* Coordinate substitutions, split deliveries, and alternate sourcing only through the required Engineering, Quality, and commercial approval processes.

2. Supplier Sourcing, Negotiation & Performance

* Identify and qualify prospective suppliers in coordination with Quality and the applicable supplier approval process.
* Solicit and evaluate quotations based on total value, lead time, technical requirements, quality, delivery, and commercial terms.
* Negotiate pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and terms within delegated purchasing authority.
* Track supplier delivery and responsiveness; document recurring issues and support supplier improvement and corrective-action activities.

3. Aerospace, Defense & Purchasing Compliance

* Ensure purchase orders accurately communicate applicable drawings, specifications, revisions, certification requirements, and customer/quality flow downs as provided by authorized functions.
* Purchase from approved sources when required; verify required supplier approvals and coordinate with Quality on supplier status and special-process requirements.
* Support material traceability and required certifications, including mill test reports, certificates of conformity, and applicable lot/heat identification.
* Maintain purchasing records to support AS9100-aligned processes, audit readiness, product safety, configuration control, and prevention of suspect/counterfeit items.
* Escalate export-control, domestic sourcing, customer-approved-source, and other contract-specific requirements to designated compliance owners; do not independently interpret or waive requirements.

4. ERP, Data Accuracy & Purchasing Controls

* Maintain accurate supplier, purchase order, promised date, price, and delivery information in the ERP/MRP system.
* Ensure purchasing transactions, revisions, acknowledgments, and documentation are completed accurately and promptly.
* Partner with Receiving, Inventory/Material Control, and Finance to resolve receiving discrepancies, invoice mismatches, and open purchase order issues.
* Identify opportunities to standardize purchasing workflows, reduce manual followup, and improve supplier and material visibility.

5. Cross-Functional Production Support

* Coordinate with Planning & Production Control on demand changes, critical shortages, and recovery schedules.
* Work with Manufacturing Engineering and CNC Programming to confirm purchasing requirements for raw material, tooling, and manufacturing support items.
* Partner with Quality and Receiving on rejected, damaged, incomplete, or uncertified incoming material; support supplier returns and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with Logistics and outside-processing coordinators on material movements, subcontracted operations, and supplier commitments where assigned.
* Communicate procurement risks and mitigation actions clearly and promptly to stakeholders.

6. Cost Improvement & Continuous Improvement

* Identify documented savings through competitive sourcing, supplier consolidation, negotiated pricing, and process improvements without compromising product conformity or delivery.
* Analyze recurring expedite charges, lead-time variance, shortages, and purchasing inefficiencies; recommend sustainable corrective actions.
* Support standard work, supplier scorecards, purchasing KPIs, and disciplined continuous-improvement initiatives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Supplier On-Time Delivery – delivery against confirmed suppli

Description:

Ready for more than just a job? Build a career with purpose.

At Lactalis in the USA, we’re committed to providing meaningful opportunities for our people to learn, grow, and thrive—whether you’re just starting your journey with us or looking to take the next step in your career. From day one, we offer the tools and support to help you succeed.

As the world leader in dairy, Lactalis is a family-owned company with over 85,000 pragmatic and ambitious professionals across the globe. Each day, we’re proud to produce award-winning dairy products that bring people together.

In the US, we proudly offer an unrivaled house of beloved brands, including Galbani® Italian cheeses and ricotta, Président® specialty cheeses and butters, Kraft® natural and grated cheeses, Breakstone’s® cottage cheese, Cracker Barrel®, Black Diamond® cheddar, and Parmalat® milk. Our yogurt portfolio includes siggi’s®, Stonyfield Organic®, Brown Cow™, Oui®, Yoplait®, Go-Gurt®, :ratio®, Green Mountain Creamery®, and Mountain High®, along with a growing family of ethnic favorites like Karoun®, Gopi®, and Arz®.

At Lactalis, we live by our core values—Ambition, Engagement, and Simplicity. We foster a workplace where innovation thrives, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone’s unique background and ideas are valued.

Even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. We want to hear about your PASSION, your STORY, and how your EXPERTISE can help us shape the future of dairy.

**From your PASSION to ours**

Lactalis USA, part of the Lactalis family of companies, is currently hiring a Sr Buyer, Rigid Plastic based in Bedford, NH.

As a Senior Buyer, the role is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies for packaging categories, managing supplier relationships, negotiating commercial agreements, identifying cost reduction opportunities, and ensuring supply continuity across Lactalis North America. The role includes strategic sourcing, supplier performance management, market intelligence, risk mitigation, contract management, budget support, and continuous improvement initiatives. Additionally, the Senior Buyer will collaborate with Plant Operations, Packaging Development, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and Global Procurement Team to align duties with the company's goals and values.

Requirements:

Bachelors’ degree in Supply Chain Management, Data Analytics, Business Management

8+ years relevant experience

Family-run and customer-focused since 1994, Automann has evolved into the leading distributor of HD truck and trailer parts. We sell to regional warehouse distributors, truck/ trailer dealers and specialty repair shops throughout the US, Canada and abroad. With more than 40,000 active parts across 17 categories from Body and Cabin components, Suspension, Steering and just about everything in between. To learn more please visit our website at www.automann.com.

Automann services its distributors out of (4) US Distribution centers; Monroe Township NJ (HQ), New Lennox IL, Duncanville TX and Ontario CA and (2) distribution centers in Canada: Brampton ON and Edmonton AB.

**Summary**

We have an immediate need for Purchasing Associate with the ability to establish and maintain a positive and professional relationship with suppliers and co-workers; cultural sensitivity and ability to relate well and effectively in a diverse workplace.

**Responsibilities**

· The Purchasing Associate is responsible for ensuring the satisfactory availability of goods to customers of the company by studying inventory levels and creating a forecast for expected usage

· Schedule deliveries. Communicate with suppliers to ensure timely delivery of products to maintain required inventory levels by monitoring and expediting orders as needed.

· Communicate with suppliers to resolve shipment issues, including defective or unacceptable goods and determine corrective action.

· Negotiate best vendor terms, pricing and delivery based on budget and schedule requirements.

· Load and maintain supplier information in ERP database. Supplier information includes contact information, supplier product pricing, supplier part number, and payment terms. Verify order specifications/packaging and pricing for orders placed.

**Skills & Qualifications**

· 2 years experience / knowledge of supply management required

· 3+ years in sourcing, planning or purchasing roles

· Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and mange time effectively

· Strong attention to detail

· Strong written and verbal skills

· Detail oriented with good mathematical and analytical abilities is necessary

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Word required

. Bachelor’s Degree in a related discipline

· Work is generally routine; most tasks are well defined, but with considerable variation; some phases of the work are less well defined and may require independent action.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive.

Automann, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, sexual identity, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $60,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Supply chain management: 2 years (Required)
* Purchasing / Sourcing: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

In this role, you will coordinate the purchasing, ordering, and fulfillment of medical supplies and equipment for skilled nursing facilities. We're looking for someone with strong organizational skills, purchasing experience, and the ability to work effectively with vendors and healthcare teams.

**Why Join US Healthcare?**

* **Monday–Friday Day Shift – NO WEEKENDS!**

**International****Purchasing****&****Inventory****Associate**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Reports****to:** R&D Purchasing
**Department:** Purchasing / Supply Chain

### **Position****summary**

The International Purchasing & Inventory Assistant supports purchasing, inventory control, and new-business coordination. The role helps ensure materials are ordered from international suppliers in line with MRP requirements, inventory records are accurate, and purchasing activities meet operational timelines.

### **Key****responsibilities**

* Review MRP requirements and prepare purchase orders for international suppliers.
* Track purchase orders and coordinate with suppliers and internal teams to support timely delivery and resolve routine order issues.
* Support inventory control by maintaining accurate records and investigating discrepancies.
* Assist with project coordination for new business, including tracking purchasing and material-related action items.
* Reconcile month-end inventory valuations and help research variances.
* Maintain purchasing and inventory data; prepare reports as needed.
* Organize and prioritize work to meet deadlines in a changing environment.
* Follow company policies, procedures, and applicable safety rules.
* Cross-train and provide support to other departments as requested.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong reading comprehension, written and verbal communication, and basic math skills.
* Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office, including strong Excel skills.
* Previous experience in manufacturing, inventory control, or purchasing—especially international purchasing—is preferred.
* Familiarity with MRP systems is an asset.

### **Physical****and****work****requirements**

* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods, with reasonable accommodations where applicable.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds, with reasonable accommodations where applicable.
* Regular and punctual attendance is an expectation of the role.
* Safety glasses are required in designated areas.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Maintains current and accurate files of suppliers pricing within the ERP system and purchasing spreadsheets.
* Assists with processing material receivers. Coordinates bulk deliveries of rough products, to meet deadlines.
* Assists with processing material returns and credits.
* Supports the RFQ, RFP processes to obtain product information such as pricing, availability, and delivery schedule.

* Basic of purchasing practices and systems preferred
* Basic time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously, while planning and executing timely, effectively, efficiently, and accurately
* Basic analytical and problem solving skills, quality oriented, and strong attention to detail required
* Ability to operate a personal computer using spreadsheet, word processing, data base software, and experience using ERP software. (COINS preferred)
* Ability to work in a continuous improvement environment
* Ability to work effectively with suppliers, customers, project management team, field staff, and accounting in a team environment.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.

**Description**

***Who We Are***

Textron Systems is part of Textron, a $14 billion, multi-industry company employing 35,000 talented makers, thinkers, creators and doers worldwide. We make things that fly, hover, zoom and launch. * Monitor outstanding orders to ensure timely deliveries of quality products to maintain production, following up on orders to expedite shipment and delivery as needed

* Obtain certifications of delivery and conduct item delivery validation. Check and improve payment of invoices
* Develop and maintain necessary records and files for compliance purposes. Support preparation of proposal cost data
* Preferred candidate will be knowledgeable in weld process, mechanical and custom fab.

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing or have completed a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or a related field.
* Ability to plan, organize and manage multiple priorities efficiently
* Effective verbal and written communications skills
* Basic Microsoft Office application skills with emphasis in MS Excel

***How We Care***

At Textron Systems, our talented people make us successful. Our Company is committed to offering employees opportunities to grow and develop. We believe in hiring great people and giving them the tools to grow, thrive, and make a difference. * Monitor supply levels and make appropriate purchases as necessary
* Evaluate vendors to determine best price and quality of supplies purchased while negotiating prices accordingly
* Receive and process all requests for supplies made by various company departments and locations.
* Allocate appropriate cost to proper location
* Retains records on purchases/requests/filled orders
* Responsible for licensing and registration of all fleet vehicles
* Travel Arrangements-Flights, Hotels, Conference rooms
* Reviews, codes and approves all invoices related to items purchased
* Coordinates and purchases food needs for meetings and events
* Contacts suppliers to schedule or expedite deliveries, to resolve shortages, missed or late deliveries, and other concerns
* Prepares, maintains, and reviews purchasing files, reports and price lists
* Tracks the status of requisitions, contracts, and orders
* Purchasing of Cell Phones and Managing of corporate account
* Purchasing of company uniforms
* Participates in department and company improvement activities, positively contributing to the team
* Proactively communicates issues and action taken or needed with Manager and/or Supervisor
* Maintains good attendance, punctuality and safe work practices
* Work in conjunction with Fleet Manager.
* Other duties as assigned

**REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS:**

* One-year certificate from college or technical school; or three to six months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Effective collaborator and communicator
* Strong facilitation and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate well with external and internal customers and management.
* Self-motivated and absolute attention to detail

**Benefits: What’s in It for You?**
As a full-time member of our Furniture Mart USA family, you will enjoy:

* Paid training
* Full benefits package: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Paid Time Off, and more
* 401(k) with employer match
* Big employee & family discounts on furniture and mattresses

**Furniture Mart USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

description:
Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager

At Capital One, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way. Our goal is simple — bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change. We are seeking a **Principal Associate, Sourcing Manager** to join our **Enterprise Supplier Management (ESM) Team**! In ESM, we empower associates to deliver their best by cultivating a culture of inclusion and belonging, where varying perspectives and opinions are valued. We embrace each other’s differences and encourage all team members to lean into their talents and skills to deliver experiences for both internal and external clients.

This Sourcing position will develop strategy for and execute high risk and high impact procurement efforts across the company. This is an individual contributor role. Working in concert with business partners and subject matter experts, the **Sourcing Manager** will develop an in-depth understanding of client needs and supply markets, then apply rigorous procurement methodology and analytics to ensure those client’s needs will be met by the selected supplier(s). This role will lead projects in indirect categories of spend include, but not limited to Marketing related services, Professional Services, IT related Services.

The selected candidate will have experience in strategic sourcing – ideally in the technology or financial services industry. He or she will have demonstrated the ability to drive positive business outcomes through the supply chain, have great communication and influence skills, high analytical proficiency, and demonstrated ability to negotiate complex agreements.

**Responsibilities:**

* Analyze external industry trends and benchmarks, as well as develop and share market insights
* Clearly articulates cost drivers and pricing analysis for strategy formulation. Leads the development of make–versus-buy strategies

- Leads innovative sourcing methods - balance cost, speed, and quality based on internal customer needs

* Build strong internal and external relationships, understand the procurement parameters and look for new opportunities
* Consult with internal clients and business partners to identify opportunities to drive cost savings and efficiency in the supply chain
* Build buy in and communicate across multiple levels of the organization and across multiple lines of business
* Manage multiple projects concurrently in an autonomous environment
* Develop and implement procurement strategies including RFx, eSourcing, direct negotiations, etc.
* Use procurement software tools
* Support the development and execution of category strategies
* Support the negotiation of commercial terms for large contracts
* Develop communications and presentations at the Executive level

**Basic Qualifications:**

* At least 3 years of experience in sourcing and procurement
* At least 2 years of experience in risk management
* At least 2 years of experience in negotiating supplier agreements

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience

* 5+ years of experience in outsourcing and procurement
* 4+ years of experience in risk management

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Sales Territory: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Plano, TX: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
McLean, VA: $120,800 - $137,900 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Richmond, VA: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
New York, NY: $131,800 - $150,500 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain
Riverwoods, IL: $109,900 - $125,400 for Principal Assoc., Supply Chain

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

Overview:

We are authentic, professional providers of fun, focused on building a Great Place To Work For All by staying true to our mission: “Life’s a Party, We’re Makin’ It Fun!” and “So Much Fun It’s Scary!”

At Spencer’s and Spirit, we do the right thing always-integrity, fairness, respect, and transparency are our foundation. You will find our culture to be inclusive, passionate, resilient, and one that values differences and embraces all.

**One Team / One Goal**

We are leaders and owners of our business success. Whether it’s developing new and exclusive costumes, quality testing products, or implementing technology solutions, our teams understand the value of working collaboratively to embrace change through innovation, curiosity, and thoughtfulness.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* *Flexible work environment*
* *Career advancement*
* *Competitive base salary*
* *Bonus opportunity*
* *Vacation, Personal, Sick and Holiday pay*
* *Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life and AD&D insurance*
* *401k with a company match*
* *30% merchandise discount*

Responsibilities:

The Associate Buyer manages purchasing and inventory for specific departments, driving sales and profitability through collaboration with internal teams and external partners. They assist in curating assortments, ensuring timely deliveries, and analyzing sales performance. The role also involves identifying new products and trends through research and competitive shopping. Additionally, the Associate Buyer helps guide and train Assistant Buyers and Senior Assistant Buyers.

* Responsible for building, creating & managing merchandise assortments that align with market and consumer trends, to be presented to the Buyer. Assortment creation includes selecting and developing merchandise by considering quality, sourcing, timing, delivery, mix, and price
* Analyze weekly sales and item performance to find opportunities and strategies to drive sales and margin
* Prepare merchandise and reports for weekly team meetings
* Manage entire product lifecycle from creation, tracking of the purchase orders, samples, merchandising in store, to markdowns and discards
* Responsible for making purchasing decisions independently that satisfy the customer demand and achieve sales, turn and margin plan
* Travel to store locations to review product mix, gather feedback, and share information with the merchant team
* Attend trade shows and travel to vendor locations to grow and maintain professional relationships with external partners, as well as gain insight on new trends and opportunities
* Maintain and grow professional relationships with external suppliers and internal partners via telephone, email, and face-to-face meetings
* Partner with leadership and planning counterparts to manage the OTB and to identify opportunities in style count, sales goals, and inventory flow
* Manage markdowns and promotion strategies

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree (B. A.) from four-year college or university; and 5+ years experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Proven ability to develop and implement strategies that drive business growth
* Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities, facilitating clear and effective dialogue with stakeholders
* Ability to work independently while also thriving in collaborative environments, taking initiative to drive projects forward
* Strong aptitude for partnering with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals and enhance organizational effectiveness
* Skilled in developing, planning, presenting, and executing strategic initiatives that align with business objectives

*The pay range reflects the potential base salary range for this role. Individual base pay is determined by various factors such as relevant experience and skills, and the scope and responsibilities of the position.*

Pay Range: $70,000 - $80,000
